review_description: Called into the office, was served quickly. All my questions were answered on the spot. The installers turned up on the day as promised, I did expect to see them as we had storms, rain hail and lightening! They manged to dodge the weather and came back and finished it off the next day. Dillon and Elliot the installers did a every good job, very neat and cleaned up after the job was finished.All the paper work was handled seamlessly.

I had my solar system installed yesterday and I could not be more pleased with the entire experience. The installation team, Daniel and Dylan, were outstanding – professional, highly knowledgeable, and courteous. Their attention to detail and commitment to ensuring everything was completed to the highest standard was very reassuring.From the very beginning, Sam provided exceptional guidance throughout the process. After years of considering solar and receiving multiple quotes from other companies, I often felt overwhelmed, pressured, and uncertain. In contrast, Sam explained everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and gave me complete confidence in my decision.The whole process, from consultation through to installation, was seamless and exceeded my expectations. I would not hesitate to recommend Solar Wholesalers to anyone considering solar. Their professionalism, expertise, and customer care set them apart from the rest.

Very happy with my decision to go with Solar Wholesalers, Sam helped guide me through the process of selecting appropriate size Solar and battery system to suit my needs without any sales spin.Quote was very competitive, quality and reliability of product depends on installation so this was key to my decision making process.Anthony did a really neat job on all of electrical work, minimal external conduits and completely rewired my switch board. I appreciate his attention to detail and listening to my requests.30 x Canadian Solar 440W panels paired with 10kW Fronius Symo Gen 24 inverter easily charges my 19kW BYD battery even on cloudy winter days.I did a lot of research, and hopefully this system will provide many years of trouble free service!

We had them install panels a few years back so when we wanted to add a battery ( before the rebate was announced) they were one of the companies we called for a quote.  Sam had a different solution to other suppliers which included more panels and explained why this would be the best option for our two phase system. We asked the other suppliers to do the same but eventually decided to go with the known supplier.The install was booked for the Monday after the weekend announcement of the battery rebate! I needn’t have worried Sam was on the case. He rang to give us options and we agreed to go ahead but not even wire up the battery.So not only did we get the rebate on the extra solar but now have the battery rebate too,System is working well and the extra solar makes all the difference.

Sales/Quoting process was informative and easy to understand.The installation was punctual, competent, polite and tidy.I was completely informed with the app on my phone, and the charger.  Excellent service.

The quote process was and seem less .the install team turned up at arranged time introducing themselves individually. Install was carried out professionally with no issues. Customer service was excellent with grid connection arranged . System demonstration received.
They offered a complete package of presale advice, installation and follow ups afterwards.All the staff were very friendly and polite.

Everything went well. They were clear on their quotes. I liked that the company has been in electrical work for a couple of decades , so most likely will still be in existence if I need them again.The young fellas doing the job were polite and knowledgeable answering any questions I had

Salesman listened to our requirements, gave multiple options, accepted that we wanted different panels to the ones suggested and most importantly did not hassle us.Installation team arrived onetime, kept us informed of the process, were friendly, very tidy and the installation was very neat.

The entire process from initial phone conversation with Solar Wholesalers to quoting, site inspection visit, installation, after sales contact and offer of ongoing support if required has been 5 stars.At every step of the way Solar Wholesalers staff took the time to explain processes, answer queries, provide advice and offer support for the installation.Very impressed. The entire installation turned out to be a seamless process.
Only group of 4 who followed through,answered questions, helped in planning {plans changed a couple times as i got an ev and reconsidered needs} then executed wellRecommended

The pre quote inspection was thorough and informative. The quote was very competitive and detailed.Three installers arrived on time and explained what would happen, discussed the best inverter location and when power would need to be switched off. Installation was amazingly completed in about 5 hours with no rush but obviously efficient teamwork. The site was left tidy after explanation/demonstration of the system, shut down procedure and the monitoring app.

I was very worried about who to use for Solar as I had heard so many horror stories. My friend said that she had used them and was very impressed so I spoke to Sam who dropped everything to go through what I needed and then gave me a recommendation on what they could do for me.The quoted price was lower that I had been quoted before so that was a good start and then the installation was a breeze and everyone was extremely polite, clean and accommodating. Everything was installed and hooked up and at the end of installation it was generating power and I could see what power we were producing and where it was going real time on my phone. So happy with everything especially as Electricity price don't look to be going down ever!

From the initial enquiry Solar Wholesalers were wonderful to deal with. Sam was knowledgeable and efficient with his quote and the team worked seamlessly with our builders.Installation was a full day process, with Jackson and his team on site ensuring it all went smoothly. The entire team were wonderful to have in and around our home. They were considerate of our space and time, cleaned up their rubbish (which is super rare with tradesmen I'm learning) advised when power was needing to be switched off, ensured we understood the system and stayed later than required when needing to finalise the last steps.We were thrilled with the final product, but even more so by the service and nature of the trades. Would highly recommend.

The sales/quoting service was adequate, and when the salesperson ultimately agreed to come to the premises, he was friendly and competent. the quotation provided was for a system that suited us, and the price was reasonable.The installation was flawless, The installers were efficient and friendly, and appear to have done their work in a neat and workmanlike manner.Connection to the grid was seamless, with very little effort from us.All in all it was a trouble and worry free process, done in a reasonable time given the Christmas break.  I would recommend Solar Wholesalers to my friends.
Sales and quoting was excellent. They were happy to discuss and be flexible around panel location to achieve the desired outcome and not have a visual impact on our heritage home
Fantastic company to deal with, we were kept up to date through the whole process, customer service is excellent. Installers were great to deal with. Very happy with our solar system.

Very happy with Huglo from start to finish. Lee was fantastic at explaining the system and process and answered all of my many questions. The installation team were efficient, polite and respectful, they also cleaned up beautifully at the end of the day.Daniel has been great in keeping us informed and checking in regularly. We did have to wait nearly 2 months for the battery but that was a supply issue and was out of Huglo's control.Overall a very smooth and pleasant experience.We would highly recommend Huglo.

Huglo is a terrific company they installed our solar panels and now a battery. Their service has always been professional and delivered quickly. I would recommend this company to anyone who wants solar.

A seamless installation by Dorji and crew. We had to make some adjustments mid-way to avoid asbestos sheeting but all was done quickly and effectively. The advice I obtained prior to installation allowed me to plan the size of the system and we now have a full battery and power to export. The final product fits neatly on roof and the wall below.

All stages and steps in this process (from first contact to sign off) were trouble free and easy.  I was expecting to be confused with technical detail and specialist speak.  Not so - all communications have been in my language and all people I have communicated with have taken special care to ensure that I fully understood answers to my questions.The design, planning, offers of various options, discussions about cost and comparisons and pros and cons of the 3 options discussed were very clear and Huglo people were very patient with me.The site visit and subsequent installation visits were enjoyable for me.The installation team was professional, efficient, arrived on time and worked constantly from start to finish.  There was no stopping for phone calls or conversations other than discussions of approach to the task and planning for and solving site problems.The team was well integrated, were familiar and friendly with each other and the Supervisor appeared to me to be the first amongst equals (ie not an officious controller) and, consequently it was a harmonious and happy team.At the end of the job all debris and materials were removed and the place needed no cleaning or tidying by me.I can not fault Huglo in any way and will promote them when I am asked by neighbours and friends about how the process went.The new installation is working really well.  I have compared the performance of the old 5.9kW system which has been replaced by the new 11.875kW system and the difference is amazing.  See photo below - please ignore the first one (mistake) and I cannot work out how to remove it..  The weather conditions on the day before the changeover and the full day following were essentially identical.I couldn't be happier (or more impressed!)

From the moment I first started a conversation with about my solar requirements with the Lee and the team at Huglo I knew I was dealing with a professional organization and not the usual run of the mill salesman. I had some more difficult requirements and it was clear these were not only understood but planned for correctly well in advance. My PM Chloe was excellent in keeping my informed about the process before and after the install. The installation team were excellent and did a really neat job with my work. To summarize I highly recommend Huglo solar for anyone serious about their energy independence.

I had a fantastic experience with Huglo and could not recommend them more highly. It has been several months since Huglo installed my AIKO Solar and Sigenergy battery/EV charger system and I have been very satisfied with the installation and after sales service.After first contacting Huglo, Lee came out to our house to do an initial look around and to learn more about what we wanted. He spent lots of time with us and provided lots of relevant information. He was a great listener, explained the differences between different options and was never pushy (far from it!). Our quote was provided electronically and it was easy to work with Lee on a couple of minor changes before accepting it.Lee also visited again for a final site inspection, then on install day everything went really well. There was one small issue with the installation which Lee and the team were happy to address promptly and at no cost to make sure we were satisfied.When the system required its first software update I had some trouble installing it. I contacted Huglo and they were able to help me out remotely. Again it was dealt with very promptly and professionally.

After two days battling Mother Nature’s winds, the legends at Huglo Energy pushed through and delivered an awesome install today.Big thanks to the team for the hard work—how good does this setup look!Running a Sungrow Inverter + Sungrow Battery paired with Aiko 475W Stealth Black Panels—clean, sleek, and ready to power on.

From the initial contact of getting the quote all the way through to job completion, the Huglo team conducted themselves in a totally professional manner. Nick and his team arrived on time and kept the work area clean and tidy, and kept us informed of their progress throughout the project. I would highly recommend this company to anybody thinking of fitting a solar system their house.
The team was very helpful and efficient.  Their followup was great.

Talking to them during the quotation phase gave me great confidence and I wasn't disappointed by the installation team, who were fantastic. A minor issue was resolved quickly and the system works great.

I've just had a REAPower 20kW battery installed by Huglo.  From initial contact, through planning, booking, answering my dumb questions and the install and follow up, Tim and the team have excelled.  They were helpful in getting a product that suited my needs and the tech guys who did the install were efficient, polite, and effective - I have a working system!  I received a follow up call and the offer of ongoing support with the app and in evaluating electricity providers.Couldn't be happier and I would unreservedly recommend Huglo.

Purchased a battery adding to a domestic three year old solar system.  Good information before contracting; flexible with installation arrangements. Responsive to my inquiries during and post installation.  Easy to deal with.

This was a company that made the whole process a pleasure.The communication and options plus answers to questions helped make it easy to decide this was who I wanted to supply and install my battery and backup system, plus upgrade my meterbox. I can now say without a doubt I was  right.The team were efficient tidy and friendly. I would have no reservations at all with recommending this company if you want a high standard of work done.
Lee took the time to explain things in detail. This company doesn't cut corners and everyone has been a delight to deal with, from the boss, to the reception to the installers.

From the very first phone call to the final handover, Huglo made going solar a breeze. We had several somewhat unusual requests and the team worked with us to find the best solutions.1) Tim, our consultant, walked us through panel and inverter options in plain language, explained the pros and cons of each, and never tried to upsell. He offered us several options, explained their differences, and updated quotes aligning with our requests promptly.2) They modelled our daytime loads and future plans and designed a system that maximises self-consumption  (as we wanted).3) The day of installation went brilliantly. The team arrived on time, kept the site clean, and completed the job quickly and efficiently. They gave a heads up when they needed to switch off our electricity and guided through the system after the installation.4) Grid connection, meter upgrade and feed-in tariff switch were all handled behind the scenes, so we didn’t need to chase any forms.Overall, we are very happy with our system. Huglo delivered exactly what they promised. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone in Canberra or beyond looking for a reliable solar partner.

From the time of initial inspection and quotation through to the full installation and certification we cannot fault the quality, communication and professionalism of the Huglo Solar Team.  Everything was made so easy on our end.
From start to finish the installation of our solar panels went smoothly. I can't recommend Huglo Solar highly enough!

Huglo Solar were very quick to reply and return calls, and they kept to appointments (weather dependent). This made the process super lovely despite complications (our distribution box wasnt big enough and our house is on 2 phase).There was a bit of correcting details with them, which required me to understand what exactly was planned, but it didn't matter much because the right people were so easy to contact.They organised grid connection, they checked the generation was as they expected, and followed up bugs with the inverter (from being a 2-phase system) months after installation.My parents also got an install by Huglo Solar, and their experience was very similar.

We received great service from Huglo from quote through to install. The team turned up on time and did a great job on the installation of solar and battery. Cleaned up the job site too. Five stars all the way
The whole Huglo team was great from start to finish.

Quick, informative and consultative sales/quoting process.Huglo started off the process of getting a smart meter installed for me.Installation was started and completed on the scheduled day.System was feeding into the house, battery and grid by the end of the day.Huglo also integrated my 7 y/o 5kW system so I now have 11.8kW of panels feeding into my house and battery and the iSolarCloud app shows the total energy from all panels and two inverters.
Very good service all round.Phil explained the upcoming battery rebate and I got a hybrid inverter for not much more.

I decided to undertake the daunting challenge of getting solar panels installed. I had delayed for many years due to shading from a double storey house next door. After reviewing the excellent website SolarQuotes I made an enquiry to 5 companies in December 2024. I chose Formula Sun because of the excellent communication, knowledge and honesty. Phil gave me full value of the STCs at 2025 rates which in fact worked out to be more than what the other companies were offering anyway.The product Phil offered me were excellent quality so I booked him in. Come installation day the installers were excellent. Job completed in about 4 hours all neat and tidy. System installed and working well.In short, Formula Sun are an honest company, offer great value, quality products, excellent communication and knowledge. I am very happy I chose Formula Sun and highly recommend them to anyone who wants to install a solar system.

Contacted Amazon Energy to install a battery (30kWh Midea Hiconics) and 6.6kW solar panel system. Was very prompt with all the replies and the was helpful with all the questions. 10% deposit was paid. Due to a cancellation from another customer, my installation got pushed to the front and got schedule 2 days after the deposit (deposit to complete installation in 3 days!).The installation was done really well with nothing to fault. The place was left tidy afterwards with all rubbish removed.The installers were also really well knowledgable and were happy to answer all questions. Lee (director) also came to visit the installation to make sure everything was going to plan.Overall a great process. Now just need to see how reliable the Midea Hiconics is over the long term but I just wanted a simple battery system that just does its own thing without any fancy extras.

The quoting process was very good. The representative was friendly and answered all my questions. The quality of installation was great, the guys were polite and did the work efficiently (as far as I could tell). The final installation was neat and tidy. All the paperwork was done for me and they explained the system and got the app working . The whole system was working when they left. Very happy so far.

An interesting and ultimately good experience with Amazon Energy.They responded very quickly with a couple of similar options and I decided to go with the FoxEss system they offered - 6.6kW of Solar Panels, 5.5kW inverter and ~14kWh of battery - as this seemed the most appropriate.Also useful to know that it was the cheapest quote I got in terms of cost per kWh of batteries - this system was basically the same price as an alternative with a 10kWh battery.Since we use most of our power in the morning and then again in the evening I was keen to ensure we had enough storage to best use the power generated.I have previously installed 2 solar systems (without batteries) in 2011 and 2015 so have a good understanding of the generation vs use time patterns.Amazon were also quick to lock in an installation day - Monday 27 October 8am.On the day I got a message at 8.15am saying that the sales person's car had broken down but "the installers should be there" - they weren't. After replying that no one had arrived we heard they were stuck in traffic. I then found out there had been a bad accident at the Freeway exit and so understood why they were late. Unfortunately, as they didn't arrive until around 10.00am they were unable to finish on the day and said they would return on the next day.That afternoon I got an email requesting a review and payment, I answered that it was a bit premature for either.I again expected them at 8am, and arranged to work from home. They arrived at 9am and started work.At around 1pm they said they were nearly finished and started turning the system on. They got me on the app and linked to the inverter and I immediately saw that there was something wrong. Apparently the house was using 10kW, with only a fridge turned on I knew that was impossible. The team were obviously keen to get away and tried to tell me it was nothing to do with them as all they had done was remove the old solar and installed the new system and had not touched anything in the house. With the old 3kW system I knew that generally between 10am and 2pm we were exporting excess energy, so I explained that I didn't agree with them and that they needed to stay and sort the problem out. We then isolated several circuits and at one point discovered that the house was apparently exporting 10kW of power in addition to the 5kW being produced by the panels at the time. It was at this point that the electrician agreed something was wrong. They then called the Fox back up team and quickly found out that they had mis-wired the smart meter. This was quickly corrected (although the mistake was not explained to me initially) and the system was finally commissioned at around 3.30pm.On Tuesday I received another request for payment, to which I replied that I would like to understand the problem, and fix, and to make sure that the system was indeed safe and working properly before making payment.Amazon followed up with a call on Friday where we discussed the issues in more detail, for which I am grateful.They also sent through the Electrical Safety Certificate confirming that everything had been checked and installed correctly.Since Tuesday afternoon we have been 100% self-sufficient in our electrical use. The battery is generally fully charged by around 1.30pm and we then export to the grid. Overnight the battery is discharging to somewhere between 30-50% at the moment although I expect that to increase once we start using the aircon.I am very happy with the system, and although we had a couple of issues wiht the installation, it did get resolved appropriately.Thanks Amazon Team. I am happy to recommend you to others.

Lee from Amazon Energy was great to work with, providing clear information on the system and answering questions promptly.The installation was neat, and the installer guided us on how to use the app, as well as how the wiring was laid out.Only minor issue with back and forth from administration team

My system was installed in June and has been running flawlessly since then.The ESS battery and software has been working very well and I have had a number of days in July/August where my property has been effectively off grid.The service and pricing from Amazon was above my expectations.

Best value for money for solar batteries. Got batteries with same cell as Tesla batteries but one third of a price with good warranty. Customer service, quoting and installation was very smooth. highly recommended.

I engaged Amazon Energy for my new solar-battery system because they visited me to discuss our needs on site. Having met them personally, I trusted them to do a good job, and they did. Our new 9.7 KW system and battery is working well.

Lee was very accommodating and helpful when I was choosing my solar battery and very competitive pricing.  He personally attended the site several times.The installers did the job to schedule and were very neat and efficientWould highly recommend Lee and his team
Lee was amazing to deal with. Everything from the quote to installation was personally overseen and nothing was too much trouble. Thank you so much for a great experience.

Lee Faisal Managing Director Amazon Energy definitely deserves a 5 star recommendation for the 10kWh Solar Battery his company has provided . Lee personally conducted 2 convenient on-site visits & his knowledge & the professional/courteous service provided is outstanding!

Lee Faisal Managing Director Amazon Energy definitely deserves a 5 star recommendation for the 10kWh Solar Battery his company has provided . Lee personally conducted 2 convenient on-site visits & his knowledge & the professional/courteous service provided is outstanding!

Walli at Greenultimate Broken Hill was extremely friendly when selling the product, we have had both battery and solar for over 6 months, neither have worked,. Walli never comes through, I have spoken to fair trading and will be in touch again this coming week. High alert - won't respond. Greenultimate if I could give less than 1 I would.

Got a quote for a 6.6 solar system approx 6 years ago. Friendly  people, good quote. Got system installed - it's been going good for 6 years and has not missed a beat. Rang them about a solar battery installation, very helpful, set up payment plan.System was installed 4 weeks ago, very professional installers, friendly and helped me set up app.system - it's going great no problems and will use them again for any solar systems.
Quite ok but could been better done and neater. Very sloppy. Working on install was told I would not need batteries so I now have to pay $6900 more to get batteries
Great product, people & service
Happy
Very impressed with the installation team's expertise and dedication to doing a good job.

Contact with all potential providers was good.Sales process was straight forward and clear. The selected provider, Perth Solar Force, were able to produce a system design for what I was looking for and with various rebates included the final configuration was affordable. Perth Solar Force were flexible on installation dates and the installers arrived when scheduled performed the work including the few adjustments that I had asked for when dealing with the Sales Rep. They work with me to place the battery storage in a location that met the necessary legislative and safety requirements as well as a location optimal for the household needs. They ensured the circuits I wanted in the event of a blackout would be powered by the batteries. The complete install took a couple of days for my two storey house, was not at all disruptive and provided a great end result.The Installers also ran through the operation of the system, shutdown and startup procedure, safety switches, documentation, ran through the various tests to confirm the system was fully operation for the various scenarios as designed and as required.It's only been a few weeks since installation and the system is working very well, the companion application is nice to use and informative. As to reliability I guess I see in 10-15 years time how it is still performing. If the equipment is as good quality as the installer I won't need to worry.Oh, and the cockatoo enjoyed having the installers around. I think they both found each other entertaining

Perth Solar Force's administration team have been great to deal with and were always very responsive. Whilst they are obviously very busy calls are always returned promptly with the required information shared.The install team likewise did a fantastic job and were great to deal with. I hadn't realised the amount of work involved in one of these installs and all three of them worked hard all day. The job that they did is very professional and like the top-notch tradesmen they clearly are they left a really tidy worksite once they had finished. I didn't envy them pulling cables in the roof and could hear how hard that was at times.Dealing with the sales side was also a pleasure. I am very happy with the equipment, it's ease of use and performance.I would not hesitate to recommend Perth Solar Force to anyone looking to have a solar system/battery system installed.

I had two of the three recommended companies visit our property to provide quotes. Both sales people were very professional, on time and prepared. Both provided options for our property and discussed the variables. We do have some large trees on the property which I value highly and wanted to keep, so things were not so straight forward. These trees grew to effectively block an old 2.2kW system on the garage roof and we wanted an upgrade. After many emails back and forth with both companies optimising a system, in the end I went with Perth Solar Force. They were able to supply a bigger than 10kW battery at a better price than the powerwall I was initially looking at and Tigo optimisers on each panel of a north (12 panels) and east (10 panels) facing system. Although the actual products are not in Finn’s top ten lists, they have as good a warranty as any and I was prepared to give them a go - hoping a top rated installer would not sell an inferior product. I wasn’t looking for a system with all the bells and whistles,  just something basic, reliable and would do the job.The installation team of four were on time on install day, though the weather conditions were not that favourable. Initial discussion on cabling between the house and garage, where the battery and inverter were installed, proved fruitful and together, we came up with a good solution for the conduits, which I can paint in future. I mostly left them to their own devices, just having a poke around from time to time. They did a very good job, dodging showers with battery installation, then back on the roof when showers cleared. I was left with a neat looking system on the house roof, tidy battery and inverter in the garage and the back up box installed near the main meter at the front of the house. The lead installer ran me through the basic operation of the system, shut down and start up procedures and an overview of the app used to monitor it. The system was installed and online in one day.Overall, very happy with the process from start to finish. Time will tell if the products go the distance without too many issues.

Perth Solar Force have provided exceptional service from from the initial sales enquiry to the installation and follow-up visits. Whilst I had a leak via a cracked tile following installation, all follow-up has been immediate and followed through until the leak was resolved. All of the staff who visited my premises were courteous and professional and were a pleasure to do business with.

Quoted a competitive price and they were the only company who could deliver exactly what I wanted. The installation was carried out in a timely manner and the crews were very tidy, clean and efficient. The communication was good, and they were quick to fix an issue with the app. Overall very happy with the process.

I’ve just had a GoodWe solar system put in by Perth Solar Force and I’ve been very impressed with them throughout the whole process.Presales: Glen was fantastic throughout the quoting process. With new state and federal rebates rolling out, the whole industry felt a bit chaotic—details kept changing and even some suppliers didn’t have the full picture. Glen stayed on top of it all, breaking down what incentives applied to my setup and how the timelines worked. On top of that, he fielded my mountain of “what if” scenarios and happily tweaked the proposal so I could compare options side by side. I never felt rushed, and nothing was too much trouble.Installation: The crew turned up on time, were friendly and professional, and talked me through placement options for the inverter, battery and cabling. They made sure I understood exactly what was going where and why. Bonus points for removing an old antenna and replacing a couple of cracked roof tiles that weren’t even near the array—completely unprompted.Finish: The workmanship is spoton. Conduit runs are straight, labels are clear and everything looks neat and intentional rather than “good enough.”All up, PerthSolar Force delivered a combination of expert advice, courteous installers and meticulous quality. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.
Easy. Good salesperson. Professional. Competitive. Seamless. Punctual. Installers professional and tidy and efficient.

The company responded quickly SolarQuotes notification of our interest. Their sales rep provided clear advice, responded succinctly to our questions, and didn't try to sell us something we did not want. In a nut shell, he was very professional. The quote was received the same day and immediately accepted by us. The office team kept us advised throughout the process. The install team were spot on time, friendly, skilled, and tidied up afterwards.The SAJ battery is due to be installed in July (post Gov't rebate).Going forward, a water heat pump will be the final piece of the project.

Salesperson was informative and friendly took time to answer all my questionsThe install team were professional and informed me of what they were doing during the whole processChecked details with me and were able to adapt the layout of some of the panels after assessing the shade that was coming from a patio roofThey did all the rebate applicationsLet me choose where the panel went and showed me how to use the app and how to read the panelThe whole experience has been excellent

Neville from Perth Solar Force was in touch within hours of my request for a quote. He came around the very next day and was a pleasure to deal with. We planned out the system, including the placement of the panels on his laptop there and then.The installer guys were also fantastic. They got all 45 panels up on the roof on a rainy day.
Everything went very smoothly. nothing more to say...product as advertised
Friendly informative salesmanGood installation team Josh,Conner and CoreyThe crew did all grid connection work and helped me with the phone app
Very good they were very helpfulGreat company highly recommend

I'm very happy I went with Perth Solar Force.They're a well organised machine. Very nice sales person (Glen) who could came to my house to understand the awkward block re: shade and size. He put up with my back and forth and changing mind a few times, sending me multiple updated quotes and options. Thanks Glen.The installation team was similarly very professional, on time, efficient and produced a great result.Top marks all around for PSF.I'll definitely be using them when I get a battery.

The Sales person was amazing, they give me the feeling that they are trying to sell me a system for me. I did take the risk with a less well known Chinese system and there was a little pressure to go with SAJ.Between the acceptance of quote and install, the process got a little messy with additional information required that could have been collected when the sales person what at my house.There is also little guidance on where the inverter should be installed. The "Leave it to the day" attitude grates on people like me who want the installation team to have a clean run at anything they need. In my case an entire shelf had to move and I did require to discuss the inverter location before the installer were on site.Installation went smoothly, after I go things out of the way. Overall the installation team were great. They were typical trade messy and also left some screws lying around my garage, where my car usually goes. A few electrical things were also left unplugged (yes a minor thing).Guidance of the use of the system was excellent.Completion of all of the required utility requirements were done in a prompt fashion.

Sales quote was good, home visit with options and explanations. Installation very good by a young team, had to deal with difficult routing of cables but worked with me to come up with a good solution. Handover and app setup done by installer with me. Works well.

I have given the quality of the system 4 stars because it has only been installed a few weeks ago.  I don't yet know how it will perform in the future.The sales/quoting process was clear and professional and prompt.The installation was tidy & punctual.  The people who came to do the installation were polite.The company must have arranged the grid connection for me after the install.I don't have a charger for an electric car.  My job was for a simple solar panel connection on the roof.
Very professional the installers informed me of what they were doing step by step, worked very professionally and efficiently
Prompt honest sales person followed up on everything I asked, site inspection completed and awaiting installation.

Solar Force provided a great salesman that walked me through all options, as well as discussing the different systems available. After considering my power needs, I settle on good quality middle of the pack system that meet all requirements. The follow up service from the office was simple and the installers arrived on time and completed the job in about 3 hours. I purchased some 12 roof tiles in preparation for possible damages during the install. Did not require any as no roof tiles were damaged. So after a few false starts I had the pleasure of meeting Louis from Positive Energy.Having not long added an EV to the garage and wanting to add a battery made for rather a challenge to design a system that would produce enough power but also fit and make use of the roof space that faces SE/SW that would usually be ignored by most installers. At our first meeting Louis had 3 different system designs with alternative batteries for each design and a few panel options at a significant discount. It was refreshing to see someone that knew all the products he was offering inside out and wanted to sell the right option for me rather than what was most profitable like many others would.At the time Tesla Powerwall 3 was just going through the approvals process and we decided to go that way as the combined inverter battery makes for a neat install and I was very much sold on the LFP chemistry for any battery that was going to live in my garage over NMC.Cut to a few weeks later and Hiroshi the electrician/installer came round with his tape measure and had to break the news that 5 of the panels were just not going to fit which would result in a drop in output of nearly 20% from the original design. Thankfully Louis had the patience of a saint and continued to come up with alternatives including some larger commercial panels but nothing was quite right. We were now well inside a month from install date and still struggling to find a panel with a high enough output, small enough dimensions to work and available before the install date. Our saviour came in the form of Aiko 475w panels available with a whole week to spare. Cutting it fine to say the least.Our final system Tesla Powerwall 3, 23 Aiko panels for 10.9kw ( 7 of which face SE/SW ) a heap of optimisers and a system that is exceeding expectations by huge margins. Synergy in their wisdom hobble ALL inverters on single phase to 5kw but as long as the battery is not full it will charge above this limit. To keep it simple I can draw the full 5kw for the house and the battery will pull up to 5kw above this. Creating this situation has seen stable solar production peaks of 9.7kw for nearly an hour on the days I actually managed to not fill the battery before 11am. Once the battery is full the system winds down to about 5.2kw for the rest of the day. Biggest days total production 60kw and consistently over 50kw even when the battery is full  well before midday.As for those panels pointing the “wrong way” they are helping me to see 1kw less than 40min after sunrise and not dropping below 1kw until just over an hour before sunset which really helps the battery through the night when I leave both aircon’s going all night.Can’t thank Louis and Hiroshi enough. System is brilliant, the install is incredibly neat and tidy, and their customer service and professionalism fantastic. In an industry full of shonky operators Positive Energy really are a gem and I hope going to the effort of writing this encourages a few readers to find out for themselves.Matt

I had a 32.2kWh SiG battery system installed to my 14.8 kwh existing solar panels in mid-April 2025 this year. While the battery itself has performed reliably, the sales experience has been deeply disappointing and dishonest.During the consultation, the salesperson, sold me a 10kWh 3-phase inverter without conducting any proper assessment of my household’s energy usage or load profile.At no stage did they ask about my major appliances, including the single-phase reverse-cycle air conditioner, or explain the limitations of a 3-phase inverter when it comes to powering single-phase loads.After complete installation, I noticed that despite having ample of stored battery power, my AC would continue drawing 1.32kWh from the grid when in use. Through several escalations, a senior manager eventually visited and confirmed the issue: the 3-phase 10 Kwh inverter could not supply enough current amps on a single phase to run the AC, forcing the system to draw from the grid—even though the battery was full.Despite admitting this issue, the company offered no concessions or try to sell this and offer the upgrade. I was told they are not responsible for checking customers’ load configurations. While I understand that customers bear some responsibility to understand their systems, a basic discussion about appliance compatibility and system suitability should be standard in the sales process, especially when selling to customers without any electrical background.Sales seemed more focused on closing the sale for commission than offering a tailored solution.Now, four months after installation, I’m facing the cost of upgrading to a 15kWh 3-phase inverter, which multiple independent solar companies have confirmed should have at least been recommended in the first place.To the SolarQuotes team. I respectfully ask that this review remain published in full. This is an honest account of my experience and I believe it’s important for other homeowners to be aware of potential pitfalls when dealing with sales people from this installer. While the SiG battery itself is a great product, the lack of due diligence during the sales process was extremely poor.

review_description: This is the 2nd PV system I have owned.My 1st PV system was when I lived in East Gippsland.Now I live in the West of Tasmania.A place where it used to rain a lot, now we just get dry lightning  :(I missed not having a PV system, especially when electricity prices were rising so much.I tried to get a PV system before, but being on a pension, no-one would give me the money.Now the government has a scheme, I can afford to go solar again  :)I chose In Series as they had a very good reputation in the business.They have been in business a long time, so they will be there when your inverter dies in a decades time.They were so easy to deal with, they handled all the paperwork, I did nothing, compared to my 1st install a decade ago.The 3 lads arrived early and went straight to workIt was a cooler day, thankfully, not in the 30s like the last few daysBut it felt like it was 28 when it was only 18!But there was a wind change on the wayIt took them less than 5 hours to install 14 Aiko panels on my roof &a 5kW Fronius inverter next to the meter boardThe fuse box is inside the houseThey did a really nice clean jobAll the cables were well hiddenThey cleaned up after themselvesThey even took the rubbish with themThen they drove back to LauncestonAn hour later, the cool change cameThat afternoon, I was standing outside looking at my Aiko'sand just smiling at them while I had how much they were producing on my mobileYes, I can monitor the system from my mobile because I got a Fronius inverterI can also do it from my computerI set-up a page on the computer & made a shortcut to the desktop so I can have it on any computerIf you want to follow my system, here is the link:-https://www.solarweb.com/PvSystems/PvSystem?pvSystemId=00c83be5-bb92-4111-a808-b3ce478711c6I recommend In Series Electrical, they did a fantastic job.  They are the quiet achievers in the PV installer industry.They do a # 1 job, but they don't brag about it, that is why they are silver, they just let the customers write reviews to sing their praisers; but how many customers actually do that after a job is finished?  Not many, customers only complain, not praise; which is what the world has turned into now.  Would I get In Series to install my PV system again?  Blood oath I would, in a heart beat, they did such a good job.  If you read their previous work like I did, it is all high praise for themAiko panels & Fronius inverter, that is what I settled on.  Fronius has been around for ages.  Aiko, they are the new kids on the block, or are they?  They used to make panels for other companies, now they decided to go alone, and Aiko is the name they trade their PV panels under.  Why do I say PV system all the time & not solar system?  A PV system is a photovoltaic system & the solar system is the planets circling around the sun.I used to have a 5kW system in my old place in the high country of Victoria & I miss it, so I was so glad that the Government has this interest free scheme over 3 years; I wish it was longer for pensioners.But I was doing ~44kWh when we had those sunny days early February, before the dry change came in.That is ~10kWh more than my place in the high country in Victoria used to do!That is unreal to do ~44kWh in a day in Tassie on a 5kW inverter.If I had a bigger inverter, it would have been higher, but I would have had to pay more for the bigger inverter5kW is the popular size, so it is the cheaper choiceI hope you have fun with your PV system, you always get obsessed with your 1st one!Is that cloud going to come overWill that tree grow too much & make shadeHow often do I have to clean it?Does it need cleaning?Get away from my panel bird, go shit somewhere elseetc          have a fun with      :)

Just say, "a newer battery with larger capacity will cost more, but you'll get more rebate back, so you won't be out of pocket any extra". Perhaps I'm being a little too pedantic on terminology?
