review_description: Sales and quoting was fast and competitive.The installation of 30 panels and the 10 kW inverter was completed in around 5 hrs . The team were punctual,polite, efficient and the workmanship was excellent.The team showed me how to use the inverter and grid connection was all organised. In 10 days we had our new 3 phase meter installed by our energy provider and are now enjoying the savings.

First up i would like to say i have never experienced 3 separate groups of tradespeople call me quickly, arrange for on site quotes and actually show up within days of being requested for a quote. Normally i am chasing tradies for weeks to get them to show up for quotes, It was a very pleasant experience getting my 3 quotes thanks to SolarQuotes.Right from the initial quoting process the company I went with, Sunlogics,  was a stand out. The person who came out to quote actually got up on my roof and had a good look, fully explained the need for optimisers with the amount of shade on my roof and explained how they worked. They explained the need for some minor works on my switchboard to accommodate the system. Neither of the other two companies who quoted got up on the roof, only one mentioned the need for optimisers, that company also noted the need for some minor works on my switchboard. The third company didn't even look at my switchboard.Sunlogics payment requirements were also reasonable, 20% deposit, balance within 15 days of invoice issue at the end of the project. The other company that was in the same ballpark price and system spec wise, basically wanted 50% payment up front, and the balance paid before installation or at the latest on the day of installation. Needless to say i wasn't doing business with them.The install crew were very professional, kept us informed throughout the process as to what was happening and showed up when they said they would. They left the site spotless after they were finished. The install ran over due to some difficulties they had getting cabling through my tight roof space, but they were able to complete the work early the next business day. They ran me through the system and made sure i was comfortable with the process for switching to backup power from the battery in the event of a power failure, and explained to me how the system works, powering the house first, battery second, then feeding the grid. They showed me how the monitoring app worked.They made what looked like a daunting process on paper a seamless and painless process from start to finish.

From beginning to end the whole process was so straightforward and stressfree. Solarquotes did exactly what they promised. Sunlogics were extremely quick and efficient. I am happy to recommend both companys. Very satisfied with the end product and the service I received.

Scott at Solar Power Panels was one 10+ quotes I obtained for my system. He is professional, communicative and informative. A conversation with him was enough to make me feel confident that I've found the right person for the job. He was able to tailor a suitable system with the features I was looking for while offering it at a competitive price. He also seemed thoughtful in figuring out the right system for me, providing me with valuable industry insights to anticipate any issues, potential shortfalls and realistic expected performance of the system. The other reviews I read from previous customers only further solidified my decision to proceed with this company.The installers were also punctual and friendly. Installation took approximately 5.5 hours and they gladly answered any questions I had on the day and ensured I was comfortable with how the system runs.I'd readily recommend Scott to any friends and family who are looking to install solar panels and batteries as I know they'll be in good hands.
Installation went well on 27/5/2022 & 1/6/22. Has been working well for last 3 years. SolarEdge 10kWh battery, Solar Edge optimisers, Hyundai panels.

I engaged Link Solar to deliver a new Solar panels and battery system. I found Christian to be very professional and took time to answer a number of questions I had to ensure I was comfortable in making a decision. I found Christian to be very knowledgeable and at no stage felt pressured to proceed. After confirming acceptance to purchase I found the communication of very high quality and understood exactly the steps being conducted and timelines. The installation teams were friendly and very efficient and cleaned up the site after finishing. Max when installing found an issue with the switchboard cabinet that had been there for many years and could have been harmful if it had not been detected. This high-level of diligence produced a very high-quality outcome for the installed system. The install team took time to explain the setup and what would happen at different points of the timeline. Christian contacted me shortly after to confirm next steps and the relevant points of contact for the Sigenerygy battery. Having recently installed I am more than pleased with the performance of the Aiko Solar panels and battery. The professionalism, communication and high-quality customer service shown by Link Solar has impressed me and I highly recommend Link Solar to other people looking to purchase a system.

I was after a small solar system and someone more local. Knowing LinkedSolar were also a family business was why I chose them. Once I made my choice Christian and Jo were very prompt and happy to answer any (and all) of my questions and installation was quick. I had good communication throughout the process. This continued when there were issues sorting out linking to the electricity supplier. The installers were friendly, and Max was happy to explain things as they happened. He and his team went out of their way to replace other broken tiles. The installation went well, the system looks great, and my place was left tidy. My system hasn’t missed a beat. I highly recommend LinkedSolar.

Very quick quote by Representative Roy. Very efficient and pleasant to deal with. Higher quality units at lower total cost. System will be completed on 3rd July. Will be installing Fronius meter and new switch board no extra cost

The sales/quoting process was very quick and multiple install variants were provided.We selected the 12Kw system with a 19Kw capacity battery.The panels and inverter were installed 2 weeks after deposit was made, they were awaiting restock of the battery provided in quote. Installer team were professional and did decent work. Majority of trade waste was collected and disposed of. The running of cabling throughout roof space was done satisfactorily and installer provided photo's of roof penetration points and weatherproofing applied.Grid connection was setup by the company quickly and promptly and we were up and running on solar same day as install.Following Panel/Inverter install I received 0 updates about status of the restock of the battery. After requesting an update, we were asked to wait a few days for an answer. 2 weeks later we were provided with an alternative battery to be installed and price difference (more expensive) was covered by Sungold Solar.from time of deposit accepted to time of battery installed was 8 weeks. Battery was installed by the installer and connected correctly and working. I had concerns with single insulated cables to the battery (plug is waterproof) but still exposed to afternoon UV. An unacceptable amount of trade waste remained at battery install site (dropped silicone, wire clippings etc.) and the warning labels stuck to the brick wall were secured with a small dab of silicone.I requested the installers return to site to rectify the trade waste, which they did 6 days later apologising for the trade waste that remained left over. I asked the installer to give me a quick explanation on how to isolate the battery/panels if I require to do so in the future, which they did.I plan on rectifying the warning labels myself (place onto a Perspex board and secure to the wall) and install a sun cover over the single insulated leads to protect from UV. I also plan on double insulating the leads running up to the battery myself with vulcanising tape and Denso.Overall i am satisfied with the product even with some of the issues encountered throughout the process (trade waste, having to prompt for an update).

Sungold Solar made my battery installation journey incredibly smooth and enjoyable. I’m very satisfied with their service from start to finish. Mr. Sayed was outstanding in his communication and commitment throughout the process. The work was even completed ahead of schedule! I’m very happy with the installation and workmanship. The electrician was highly professional and clearly experienced, knowing exactly what he was doing. Honestly, I wish I could give more than 5 stars!
Short lead time of 2-3 weeks. Install looks good.Friendly install team.
Loved everything these guys did but post install they go missing. No one wants to answer a simple question.

A huge shout out to Finn and his team at Solar Quotes, they took all the hassle out of endless hours of research and made the Solar transition simple. I cannot thank you enough.We chose Sungold Solar to instal our system and you couldn’t fault a thing, from our initial meeting with Anis to the installation from Sam’s team it was the most professional process we’ve ever experienced.  Thank you very much

All aspects of the quoting process, sale and installation were exceptional.The system quoted was upgraded due to panels not being available at the time.The installation was seamless with experienced tradesmen on site.Sungold were a pleasure to deal with and would recommend them to anyone looking for solar installation.

Sungold Solar great competitive quote for a top system.Came out and checked the site prior to providing quote.Installers were great. Very neat and tidy.Our system look great on our new roof and all working exactly as they told us it would.

the quoting process was easy and easy to understand.The installation was good and done within half a day. The workman were tidy and punctual .The customer service was great all i had to do was pay ,as they did everything for me.

We had a fantastic experience with Sungold Solar from start to finish! The sales process was smooth and transparent, with everything explained clearly and no pressure at all. On installation day, the team arrived on time, were very friendly, and kept the worksite tidy throughout the job. They completed the installation efficiently and left everything spotless.After installation, I was pleasantly surprised to receive a follow-up call from the Sungold Solar team to check in and get my feedback. It really showed their commitment to customer care and made me feel confident that they stand by their service. So far, the system has been running perfectly, and while I haven’t needed any further support, it’s reassuring to know their team is just a call away. Overall, I couldn’t be happier with the whole experience!

Excellent, efficient service, great value and everything was so seamless. Anis was a great help and was always there to answer all queries and assisted with setting up my Bluetooth with my battery. No cpmplaints.. excellent from the day of the quote to installation and after care! Thank u

I recently engaged Sungold Solar (Ingleburn, NSW) to supply and install a 20kWh Alpha ESS Battery System with the Smile M5 inverter, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the service.From the start, the team at Sungold Solar were responsive and transparent. They explained the system components in detail and answered all my questions promptly, both over the phone and via email.The installation was done efficiently, with great attention to safety and neat workmanship. The installers were punctual, professional, and left the area tidy. They also took the time to walk me through the system’s operation, which was very helpful.

Quote was quick and competitive. I chose Sungold as I had a good experience with them when getting solar panels. Communication for arranging an installation date could have been a bit better, though I do understand there was a delay due to supply shortage.Installation team was friendly and knew (and checked) all the legal requirements regarding fire safety etc for the proposed installation location. They made sure the system was working properly before getting me setup on the phone app to control the system.

Syed and his team are thorough professionals, great product, advice and after care customer  service were stand outs for me. Syed takes extra care in ensuring the best solution is offered based on customer needs. Another good thing about Syed was that he doesn't unnecessarily cross sell or over sell. Thoroughly great experience. Would absolutely recommend speaking to Syed and team for expert advice.
Very professional service was provided at a very competitive price. They were both helpful and efficient from the beginning to the end of the process.  We highly recommend them.
Mat was super responsive but friendly and didn’t pressure us. He came to meet us on a Sunday and made it all really easy to understand.

Matt was very prompt and easy to deal with. He explained everything in full detail, his quote was very professional and extremely detailed. When the team installed the new system they were very polite, obviously very knowledgeable and they even cleaned the whole site inside and out when the job was finished. Can't recommend them highly enough.
Very easy, start to finish. Very professional from initial contact to completion.

Quick response to my enquiry. Keen to come up with the best solution for my needs and brave enough to challenge on incorrect assumption I had. Professional, responsive to any questions and delivered on everything they promised me.
Great job ? the best people toWork with communication very good

Tmec sales explained the process fully and their quote reflected our conversation. They were the lowest quote, and the entire installation process was both efficient and professional. Their team was punctual, polite, helpful and left the worksite clean. I would happily recommend them.

I couldn't be happier with my dealings with TMEC Services.The salesman visited our house 3 days after I had requested quotes from Solar Quotes.  He was a repurposed tradie who actually knew what he was talking about and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't require. The quote came the same day and was so reasonable I signed straight away.Less than a month later two very pleasant tradies came and spent a couple of days removing the old system and installing a new inverter and panels. They listened when I told them my preferences for how the panels should be positioned on the roof.  They were unable to install the battery as it was still in China!.When the battery arrived they came back and installed that and made sure the system was set up as I wanted.A really neat install and they left the work area spotless.So everything was up and working 8 weeks after I had first contacted Solar Quotes and at least 2 of those weeks were waiting for the battery to arrive from China.Emails have been answered the same day as they  were sent - often by Tom Murray, the TM in TMEC Services.  Always good to be able to talk to the boss!
Good service and excellent communication. Competitive pricing. Very positive overall experience

Excellent installation, all done in a day, system set up and grid connection were all taken care of. The installers( Leigh & the boys) were efficient and polite and most definitely knew what they were doing  Communication with Green Vision Solar was all done by Email (not very personal) As I'm a pensioner I found it difficult. But we got there in the end.
Very smooth process and great customer service. Highly recommend Green Vision Solar and their Installer.
From the start to completion, the crew at Green Vision Solar were great to deal with.Great product with amazing service and communication.Highly recommended.

We recently had a large and complicated battery system installed by Green Vision Solar and they did a brilliant job. It was far from easy but they worked through every issue without ever compromising on quality. Really appreciate them getting such a difficult job done and getting it done so well. Would definitely recommend them to others.
Very happy with the service they were very punctual and the installers did a fantastic job. Will definitely recommend.
Oliver helped me from start and beyond with information and support to achieve the system I wanted. A1 customer service!! Since installation the system has been amazing. Very happy

Few months after installation I realised that the installed Fronius inverter didn't have the correct front cover. The model in the quote was GEN24 8.0 Primo, but the cover was labelled Symo (3-phase variant of the GEN24 8.0), The sticker on the side of the device was all about GEN24 Primo. I could not get an explanation for the mix-up from the installer, electrician, or Fronius Australia and suggested that Fronius would provide a replacement front cover saying "Primo" and Green vision would install it.  Fronius made the delivery to my home September 23, 2025 and I am still waiting for Green Vision to send somebody to install. The response to my repeated queries about installation date is "we will call you once we have the date available"

Quote was good. Was kept informed about the installation even though it was delayed slightly. Very efficient installers, was inspected and operational within 2 days of installation Everything was done when they said it would be.
Communicated with Oliver over a year before getting solar and battery installed. Always helpful and accommodating of my queries. All issues sorted with great communication and fairness in mind.

Process was fairly smooth, able to answer my questions promptly, and explain rationale.Installer was punctual and tidy.Customer service was smooth, but would have liked a bit more information about the steps of the whole process.

Quoting and sales process was smooth and easy.  Oliver's communication was very good (included a site visit).The installation went well. The subcontractor Mark and team from Seam Electrical did well and were very accommodating and helpful.The overall customer service was good.I recommended Green Vision Solar to my brother-in-law.   I understand he also had good dealings with Oliver and a Sigenergy system has now also been installed at his place in a surprisingly short time.

Oliver responded to my enquiry very quickly and ran through my requirements before sending an itemised quote promptly. Being new to the Sigenergy system, he was very patient with my change of specifications until I finally worked out what we really needed for our household. Having three phase in my household, it took some time to understand how the Sigenergy Energy Controller works as a full backup solution.We paid our deposit at the end of May, confirmed our final specification mid June and finally got the system installed end of July. It was delayed a few times because of the widespread Sigenergy stock issues which was expected. Both Carla and Oliver kept me in the loop until installation day.On the day, Leigh and his apprentice installed the battery and did an amazing neat job. Having a brick veneer house, they were able to hide all but one cabling behind the walls so at the end the installation looks fantastic. Leigh is probably the cleanest sparky I've dealt with, cleaning up all the mess they made before they left.The Sigenergy system requires after installation support as well, being new to the system and Sigenergy being new to the industry we were able to resolve minor issues together and Oliver was very responsive each time.After all that, the system is running exactly as how it should be. There are some minor issues with the MySigen app not quite correctly showing net metering data correctly but it doesn't affect general everyday use.Between the three options I had at the beginning, I wouldn't hesitate to ask Oliver to install my system again.

I recently had a 40kW 3-phase solar system installed by Green Vision Solar, and I am beyond impressed with both the quality of the system and the service provided. From start to finish, the entire process was seamless.The system itself is fantastic — the quality of the panels and setup is top-notch, and I can already see the savings on my energy bills. The team, led by Oliver, was incredibly professional. He was punctual, ensuring everything was done on time and to perfection. The installation was completed quickly and efficiently, without any unnecessary delays.Oliver and the team took the time to explain how the system works, and I felt confident in my decision from the moment I signed up. It's clear that Green Vision Solar prioritizes quality and customer satisfaction.If you're looking for a reliable, efficient, and professional solar company, I highly recommend Green Vision Solar. They’ve made the switch to solar energy easy and stress-free

Green Vision Solar were incredibly fast getting back to me when I initially reached out for 3 quotes, through Solar Quotes. The teams communication and customer care is first rate. Oliver listened to what we required and came up with a great design. There were frustrations with supply timelines but this was an industry wide issue due to the battery rebate and subsequent high demand Australia wide. Again, communication was excellent and always polite. There quote was cheaper by $1,000's and there deposit was on 10% despite the uncertainty of the rebate when then order was submitted. I wondered whether Green Vision Solar was too good to be true, their reviews said that they were and I confess I was wary but they have done everything they said they would do and with a very high level of service.The installation in the end, was very quick and they did a very neat job and cleaned up after themselves. I was shown how to download, log into and use the app. Again, all first rate service.We are in the process of grid connection. There was a small error in the submission of the paper work but this was rectified within 15 minutes once it was discovered! We are only human and the 15 minute correction was extraordinarily fast.Green Vision Solar know how to run a business. Oliver and his team are fantastic, as is Leigh with his installation team.

Seam Solar & Batteries, the subcontractor to GVS for my job, overcame some hiccups on the day but still completed the installation speedily. Paper warfare was all handled smoothly by GVS. We would use them again.

Green vision and Oliver were fantastic to deal with. At no point was I given a sales pitch. He wasn’t trying to move the brands that offer him best commission.When I asked for quotes I had done some research and I had an idea of the system I wanted. Oliver listened, offered suggestions and gave me the system I wanted. And price wise he was one of the better ones.Or you went someone who doesn’t try to sell you snake oil Oliver is the way to go. He’s the real deal.
Very fast, efficient and a very professional organisation. I have recommended them before and will again.

Oliver at Green Vision always returned my call. Oliver worked through every issue and was always courteous and patient. His solar knowledge is comprehensive and accurate.The installation crew was very experienced, prompt, courteous, clean and tidy.I would highly recommend this company to those looking to go solar and battery.
They helped me through the whole process and provided me with all in information that I was after.

We received two good quotes for the solar installation on the same day as our request via Solar Quotes. We selected Green Vision Solar on the basis of the length of the guarantee period.GVS were quick and efficient in the pre-install set-up. The equipment was delivered two days prior to the planned install date. The installation team arrived on the promised date, and worked safely and efficiently. The installation is neat, and the work area was tidied up at the finish. We had spare roof tiles available, but none were needed.GVS arranged the grid connection, which took place really quickly.The GVS technician downloaded an energy management portal and showed us how to use it.In subsequent days we reported to GVS that the inverter was showing a "warning" indication. This was quickly attended to.The system is now fully functional. As with all new tools, we need to learn how to use it.
The guys were so communicative - made the whole process for solar on our house very straight forward.  Installation team were also on time and efficient.
Oliver and the team did a great job installing 13.3kW of solar and a 10kW Sungrow battery for a fantastic price.

Sales quoting and on-site inspection timelyInstallation team very polite, today and punctual. They seemed like a very young Cohesive teamCS helped to organise Grid connection  after install but needed prompting  how to sync and use the mobile app.

Green Vision Solar provided a seamless process from beginning to end! The customer service was great, the communication was fantastic and the job was done with care. The team left our house spotless.  Can’t recommend them enough!!

All three quotations were very professional. Offer to source any needed tiles sealed the deal. A very professional, safety conscious and efficient crew of installers (led by Leigh) with a very tidy result going the extra step to connect to www by ethernet cable rather than wifi. Salesman (Oliver) continued to be available through the installation and after the installation to answer & resolve any queries.Grid connection is pending.
Yes - the process was well explained from the start of the initial process to the final installation.Every step of the way we felt well supported and informed.
We found Green Vision Solar very thorough and professional in the quoting, communication and delivery of our solar upgrade. The electrical contractor was also quick, efficient and helpful.

Very impressed with all aspects of the process. They were polite, professional and very very clever! They answered all my stupid questions were exceptionally neat and did not leave any mess. I cannot speak highly enough of the Dynamic Duo. Even the inspector Irish James was a real darling. I would not hesitate to recommend GREEN VISION.

We purchased a Sonnen Evo battery because it was the best configuration, capacity and value. This was added to an existing 10 YO PV system. The sale process was a little protracted because of site complications. Green Vision Solar seemed most clearly onto the issues and agreed to organise the relocation of a gas water heater.The installation itself was straightforward and prompt even with a delay for a plumber to attend. An inspector attended within a few days and was complimentary about the quality of the installation.So far, the battery appears to be performing as expected. The Sonnen app installed easily and is very informative. We hope that if problems occur, we will have suitable support.

The sales quoting process was excellent. After approval, I did not receive a hello. I guessed it was busy after new year. When it was finally installed after my follow ups, I have to say hello again. After 2 weeks it was checked and turned on. I had to update them. Up to now waiting for certificate and hopefully hear from them soon next week so we can finally use it.

We live in a townhouse and Oliver was the first person at a company we’ve spoken to who was very realistic about the amount of panels that would fit on our roof (able to squeeze in 14, and if you live in a townhouse a site visit might be a good idea for precise measurements).They were also able to offer whichever brand of panels (I started off requesting Trina but we went with Jinko as they are a bit more suitable for varied roofing).I would suggest insisting on an installation date before transferring a deposit, as it was quite a while after what had been discussed on the phone in the end (given this was in November of course some leeway is understandable, especially as STCs reduce at the end of the year).On the day Leigh and the team were straight up on the roof and for a pretty tricky install were done by about 3:30.I was very impressed that everything was cleaned up, all packaging, broken tiles and rubbish included.We only waited five days after install for the inspector (which was very pleasantly below the 10-15 days I was advised might be the case). There was a minor issue with one connection cable to the inverter so only two sets of panels were able to be turned on immediately. Leigh the installer was back less than 24 hours after this was identified and the issue was fixed within ten minutes.4/5 for Customer Service as was unable to reach someone on the business landline when I tried on several occasions, but responses by text are pretty good, with emails also responded to quickly.This review has been done before connection to the grid, which is expected to take a while.

The guys from FX Energy were absolutely fantastic to deal with right from the first call and meet with Ian through to the installation.  They were at our home on time they worked very efficiently and nothing was a problem. I requested the solar panels to be put in a certain place and they accommodated me with yes that is no problem.The after sales service was so good I have not received it like that before with phone calls at the end of each month to check up if all was good .Great job 100/100Peter
Fantastic to work with from start to finish an easy process. Great customer service. Great installation crew, quick and efficient.I can’t recommend enough.
The installation team ran is through the system and how the inverter worked. Also informed me what the next steps would be. Set up the App and have booked in the Inspector for the final tick off.
Still navigating the app butt all is good seems to be on right track for the amount of panels (10)Very good company

Great customer service, very prompt in replying to emails, and proactive in seeing if we had any further queries.Very knowledgeable and professional solar experts, would definitely use them again in future for a battery or heat pump.
Very good service  & price. Helpful through whole process. Excellent install.
Excellent job, had to wait for battery delivery, installers were on time and did excellent job. Also helped me the app working. Very happy with whole job.

The quoting process was straight forward.The installation team was on time and worked diligently all day to get our system completed.After installation a training session was completed on how to use the app.
FutureNRG were able to answer any questions we had and quickly organised an install for the best quoted price we could find in our area. Installation was quick and done well.

Very happy with the sales/ quoting process. The sales person did his best to explain, manage and involve us fully in a complex project. Service above and beyond.Installation was brilliant . Installer always tried to answer questions and explain things in layman's terms. Hassan  and his team were respectful, polite, tidy and convivial. Hassan worked very hard putting in long hours to ensure the system was successful. Highly recommend!!Customer service was always helpful, polite and patient. They made multiple attempts at times, sometimes after hours,  to contact me and resolve various issues. Sometimes it was difficult to phone Head Office as nobody answered the phone but when contact was made consults were extensive and satisfactory.We have had three solar quotes/ installations done over the years and this is the Best experience.They go above and beyond and I highly recommend.

We were very happy with the whole process of getting a solar battery quoted and installed. Evan was great to deal with and answered all my questions, explaining everything very clearly. We were happy with the price and with the proactive customer support from Evan, Ethan and the team at Electrifying Australia both before and after our battery installation.

We have existing Solar Panels and were looking for a battery retrofit. After reviewing a number of quotes from different installers and having follow up questions, Simon from Electrifying Australia was the only sales rep to respond. As we aren't planning on being in our current residence long term, one of the most important factors was a high ROI and EA's quote certainly provided that.The initial consultation was technically challenging due existing single phase PV on a three phase system, but Simon came up with an ideal solutionDue to low stock levels with the current battery rush, installation was slightly delayed, but to ensure it wasn't extended  we were given a free Inverter upgrade at no costInstallation went well, even though our board is very old and wiring is getting dated. They were very polite and helpful and cleaned up once completed.Overall very happy

Electrifying Australia is a very considerate Company to deal with. The process of answering all of our questions and ensuring that we were able to make an informed decision about the right system for us was an effortless process. Sam Music, Sales Manager was in constant contact to help us with all of the information. The quote was an excellent price and it was an obvious choice to go ahead with Electrifying Australia.After a few days, we were contacted and the system was professionally installed. The wiring is very neat and concealed in the walls. A long cable run meant a short time the next day was required to complete the installation. Commissioning done, the new 25kWh Anker Solix X1 AC Coupled System was charging from the solar panels and powering the house that night. We were told how to operate the system before the installer left.We are most pleased and excited about our purchase and highly recommend Electrifying Australia to prospective buyers.

I'm very happy with the performance of the new solar and battery system. The project moved quickly, completing in only a few weeks. Noah deserves a big shout-out for his exceptional service. His patience and diligence helped to ensure all my questions were answered and I got the best system I could for my house.

I now have a Sigenergy 3 Phase 15KW Hybrid Inverter with 10KW of panels, 32KWh of battery and a Gateway providing full house backup. It’s been a very technical journey to find the right solution for our needs. Maha from Electrifying Australia was very responsive with providing options and responding to the changes I requested. I think my needs where somewhat new for them as I have a Clipsal C-Bus 3 Phase house setup meaning that full house backup was the only real solution. Then came the challenge of the shortage of supply due to the battery rush. Maha offered other options, but I stuck with the Sig option and accepted the November install date (quoted in September). The system was live on the 4th of November.The installation process went well and the team where good to work with and happy to support our requirements. The main challenge was the weather, either getting too hot to work on the roof or raining causing the installation to take longer than expected. The design was also tuned during the installation process (changing the distribution of panels across the north and east sides of the roof).Why did I go with Electrifying Australia:-	They are responsive,-	Their advice made sense and are open to exploring different options,-	Price was good,-	The others failed to respond when they said, proposed things that did not make sense, quoted on products they where not using on their own home (they were installing Sigenergy at home but suggesting something different for me without a good reason), and quoted a higher price.I would do it again - Yes.The one thing I did not realise was how much heat a 15KW inverter creates. I now have a heater in my garage. Something to keep in mind for people thinking about installing solar.

The sales and quoting process was clear and straightforward, with helpful advice on system options. Zac and his team installed the panels and inverter in no time, even on a very hot day. They were polite, tidy, and professional, and Zac showed me how to monitor the system and use the inverter/charger app, making everything easy to understand.The customer service was excellent. They organised the grid connection, followed up to ensure everything was working.Overall, I’m very happy with the system and would gladly recommend them.

Dealing with Electrifying Australia was a good experience with no problems. All my questions were answered and the process proceeded quickly from initial discussions to installation of the new battery.The installers came on the scheduled day and completed their work without any issues. The system is working well and it is great seeing the battery charge up to use when the sun has gone down.

Sales provided good information and cheap pricing compared to others even though the inverter was entry level, it was still the better of the entry level.For a small system like what I got, it does the job well.Installation went smoothly and all was working as expected.

I contacted Electrifying Australia when I saw that it had high ratings with excellent reviews.The quoting process for my needs was originally started by team member Jaye with interaction by founder Shyamal.After discussing my house needs (worked out via Energy bills I have paid in the past four quarters) it was agreed that the following system was required. review_description: RAW Power and Lighting were very efficient and called me immediately to provide a quote. Whilst I was not looking for the cheapest system they ended up providing me with a top quality set up at a very affordable price. They were very helpful from the start and the whole thing was finished within three weeks. Very courteous guys doing the install and everything was left tidy at the end. They were more than happy to explain how it all works and at this stage I couldn't be happier. I would highly recommend them to others.

Ryan was great with communication and information needed for us to decide on the right system.  Installation went smoothly.  Guys cleaned up well.  Nic organised everything for us - so very stress free!  Would totally recommend RAW Power and Lighting.  In fact, we are getting further electrical work soon with this company.
Simple quotation to understand. Answered questions well. Timely. Think I’ll be happy with the system when it’s finally up and running.
Raw power and lighting were great. Easy to deal with, efficient and pleasant to deal with. Happy with my solar.

RAW Power and Lighting did an outstanding job installing my solar system. The workmanship was top quality, with every detail finished to a really high standard. What impressed me just as much was their flexibility — not only did they take care of the solar installation, but they were also happy to tackle a few other jobs around the house at the same time, which made the whole process so much easier for me.The team was professional, reliable, and great to deal with from start to finish. I’d highly recommend RAW Power and Lighting to anyone looking for skilled electricians who go above and beyond for their customers.

Initial sales service and helping me work out what I wanted was excellent - I got exactly what I wanted from that process with a lot of advice and support along the way for a very competitive price. Very knowledgableInstallation was... not great.* I had serious amounts of concrete dust/debris left inside the house, ceiling cavity and outside from installing the brackets on my concrete tile roof. Only partially remedied when they vacuumed out the easily accessible third of my roof space - but then left the rest.* I have some split rafters from them not pre-drilling before driving pretty large screws into them for the brackets.* I had a couple of cracked tiles discovered underneath some of the solar panels (on a freshly restored roof) that neither the solar installer or roofer was willing to take responsibility for. But the installer did want to charge me for a full day's work to come and remove/replace 2 panels so I could get those tiles replaced. They are on the Gold Coast, I am in Toowoomba. No allowances made for their potential culpability until I fought it.I gave up and some items remain un-raised and unaddressed. It was exhausting having to fight them on everything to get anything fixed. Very poor customer service in that regard.Electrically I have no idea. I am unqualified and could not tell you if what I got is up to scratch. To a layman, it looks good.Grid connection and setup for monitoring was excellent. I didn't have to do a thing there.All in all - I really hope that my system stands the test of time and just keeps working for me so that I don't have to deal with the installer again.

Raw’s customer rep, Ryan was amazing at keeping me informed and taking me through all the options, despite me having a million questions. I never felt pressured to sign on with them like other companies, and as they have a small team I knew who was going to be responsible for the install. When talking with others about when they had solar installed they’d often say that they had no after installation follow up. But Raw took time to call me back on a Saturday morning to see how things were going and give me an update.

Quoting and install was all quick, efficient, genuine and user friendly. There was an issue with the hot water timer and they came back the same day I called to let them know. The service to ensure it was fixed was incredible.

Ryan was a font of knowledge and the conversation was easy to follow, very informative, and I felt no pressure.I was very pleased with the quote.  I had gathered four quotes in all and Raw Power and Lighting was the 2nd cheapest, but I felt most comfortable going with them.Nic and his team arrived at the agreed time and were professional and tidy.  The hybrid inverter set-up is neat and tidy.  Nic showed me how to use the app (very easy) to view how much power was being generated by the panels/ how much power was being used by the household/ how much power was going back to the grid etc.Everything with the energy supplier was organised for me by Raw.  I don't think the whole process could have been any easier.
Did not have to worry about anything installation install grid if I had a question they would answer it polite nice people The sales person was factual helpful would definitely use them again.

Ryan at sales was very responsive and competitive. They are a smaller local firm- so more ownership on the service itself. I did not need too much detailed information on operating - but i would imagine they would offer that at installation for other customers.
Very easy quoting process and very helpful before and after install.

The quoting process was super prompt after enquiry through solar quotes. Got two recommended installers, Raw Power surely stand out from being prompt to have a chat to find out our needs and although they are not the cheapest. But they gave good recommendations although I did give the brands I wanted after doing my own research. Ryan who was involved in quoting process was very prompt and friendly. I like the fact that he actually takes my calls or questions even outside office hours (as it was hard for me to take calls during office hours).One key thing that also stands out was that he highlighted that Nic the owner, is the installer and makes sure everything goes well, and that really gives me assurance when the boss is out and doing the actual installation. Nic arrived on installation day early, very polite and explains the process and what's going to happen. They helped to connect everything at the end, make sure everything was cleaned up well and done properly, to the process of teaching you about the app and what it means. I have to say I'm extremely pleased with the outcome and whole process. Highly recommend Raw Power & Lighting, and thank you Nic and your team member for your hard work installing the solar on such a hot day!
The whole process from sale to after sales was super simple and fast. The staff were friendly and helpful. Very happy with Aussie Solar Batteries.
Totally professional team with above and beyond customer service. These guys know their  business and deliver the goods. So glad I chose SJ Power for my installation. Highly recommend.

Fantastic team from the start, after being contacted by Clare the office manager and asking a few questions and getting pictures to arranging site visit with Shea the owner to the install team I could not ask for anything more, they was on time, polite, and tidy.After the install they gave me a run of how the system works with instructions and APP monitoring, after install Clare followed up and completed final paperwork for grid connection with no hassle or stress, .

I decided to go with SJ Power and can say that thier service was 100% from day one to the completed installation and beyond. The intial meeting was very helpful and detailed everything I needed that will suit the already installed solar panels, then the crew that worked on the installation were outstanding, kept me up to date on their progress and took me through all details once completed. Help me out installing and understanding the app to monitor the solar and batteries performance, they also came back a couple of days later to sort out some annomalies they had found. Very helpful and I'm very pleased with the results

I first installed solar panels with them and didn’t hesitate to contact them again when I decided to add a battery and EV charger. The team was professional, efficient, and knowledgeable from start to finish.Hannah, the sales manager, took the time to explain everything clearly, adjusted the quotes to fit my budget, and genuinely listened to my needs. Claire ensured smooth communication throughout the process, making everything seamless. A big thanks to Ethan and the installation team for their excellent work and their professional, polite communication.And thank you, Shae  for leading such a great team, that’s why I like to support local businesses like yours. The customer support is also excellent: if you have any issues with your system, you’ll be promptly and reliably assisted.Highly recommend SJ Power to anyone looking for expert, trustworthy solar installation,

We had our battery installed by the team at SJ Power. Tyler, Liam, Dylan and Hunter were a great bunch of guys who were prompt, quiet and did a quality implementation. They set the battery up and gave me a run through of the process and tools used to manage our power usage. The app is intuitive and gives a simple reflection on performance. Would recommend Shae and team for anyone looking to level up their solar efficiency game!

Sales person was friendly and helpful, took time to answer my questions. Came in person to visit and quote (other companies did not). No high pressure sales techniques. On the day the installation was on time, efficient, clean. No issues. App connection sorted on the day.

Salesman was great - agreed to everything. We have a tricky house, but everything was doable. We signed a contract and paid deposit in April.A second person came to inspect - said the house was tricky but all was fine.Install date was September. The installers arrived and felt the job was tricky. They didn't want to install that day.We received a call from Solaire later that day saying the job was tricky and they weren't going to do it as it would cost us more than it's worth. I asked for them to provide a revised quote.They emailed saying that they weren't going to do the job and would refund the deposit. I have asked for a proper reason and they have not replied. I asked for them to refund deposit plus interest and they have not replied.This is breach of the contract.We now have no idea why it's tricky to install and we are struggling to find another contractor to do the job - we signed up in April to beat the rush only to be screwed over.
The whole process from first home visit to discuss options to follow up, subsequent questions through to installation went very smoothly. Really pleased with the outcome.

Sales rep was responsive, but didn’t provide additional relevant information unless specifically asked or missed info that I discovered later on from Synergy. The installation itself was neat and carried out by a friendly team, though some miscommunication meant I had to follow up afterwards for operational settings for charging from the grid.

Excellent and seamless process start to finish. No damage to roof tiles either very impressive. Supplied additional tiles in the event of and left them with very kind. Complex install of using 5 seperate sections of the roof, so as to maximize solar panel exposure very professional

Contact from sales was quick and easy after seeking advice from Finn. Neil was fantastic. Great induction to solar for newbies, and many simple early answers to our many questions.Quote received quickly, lots of post advice resulted in our choice to seek system flexibility.Install was completed in a day, with a two week lead time. Cade and the team were very professional, including relevant checks and certification. Electrical cert and follow up with Synergy, all completed via Nicolle in the office. Even assessed and returned to reposition a panel, to improve the solar systems performance.Overall a Great Experience. Thanks to All.
salesperson knew his product and answered my questions, installation was good, company followed up on questions. I am happy with the system

Solaire Connect were the first to contact me and only one to send a sales person to arrange an appointment.The installers on the day were very helpful in explaining the location of the inverter and panels.The finish was very neat and tidy, I'm very happy.

Right from my first phone call through to the last trades person I dealt with, the customer service was excellent. Erin on the phones was very helpful with my initial enquiry. She was personable, listened to my needs, understood my level of knowledge and provided an appropriate level of information. Neil my salesperson was very helpful and easy to contact. He spent a long time with me at my home explaining my options and answering my many questions. He would even respond to my afterhours email questions within 5-10minutes and was always happy to make a phone call to explain things.The trades people that came to complete my install were knowledgeable, efficient, and polite and they cleaned up well after they had finished the work. I was shown how to use the inverter, and they ensured my app was working correctly prior to leaving.I had paid for a plug to enable power from the solar panel to still be accessed during a grid outage and this was not provided to the installer on the day of my installation. This was rectified quickly and installed a few days later with good communication.I was very happy with the service I received at all stages of my solar experience.
Brad was very helpful, factual and easy to deal with. Not pushy.
It was a smooth operation  from  start  to finish  kept  informed about the progress

After installing the SMA 6.6kWh solar system on our home, I’ve been really impressed by its performance, reliability, and smart energy management.Installation was handled professionally and took just one day. The system came online immediately, and the post-installation support has been excellent.At current energy prices, we’re on track to recover our investment within 5–6 years. Plus, it’s battery-ready if we choose to expand down the track.
Sales rep was very informative and helpful. Installers were prompt on site, tidy, efficient, pleasant.  Very happy with the system.

Solaire Connect were great from start to finish. Any questions were answered promptly.  The installation was quicker than I expected and they were flexible working with my availability.Highly recommend.

Very happy with the whole team at Solaire. I found them to be better than others I got quotes from who inflated their pricing on very average systems. I only found this company by chance as I was looking into batteries and Solaire was recommended by battery manufacturers. I'm glad I did as the system I got is superior. Thanks to the team at Solaire who were competitive in pricing and also got my system installed in such a short time frame.
Wasn’t the best price initially but they price matched in the end and provided the best service

Absolutely amazing company, couldn’t recommend higher. We did our research and got quotes from a number of suppliers and we are beyond glad we went with Solaire Connect. From first contact to final install it was first class. From the Director through to the installers and office staff, everyone cares about what they do. Customer service is a forgotten art these days but not here, it was and still is exceptional.Value for money: 10 out of 10Quality of system: 10 out of 10Installation: 10 out of 10Customer Service: Incomparable. 20 out of 10.A company built on quality who cares about what they deliver who will design a system perfect for your needs. They did everything, including the grid connection after install. I’ve also never seen cleaner trades or more precise work. From director down they take pride in their work and they care about what they do and deliver. We wanted a bigger system and everyone was happy to take our money and suggest three phase upgrades etc but Solaire Connect’s Director met with us, made himself available, worked through our energy needs and delivered a system with hybrid inverter that was perfect for what we need at a fraction of the cost, and of the highest quality; that’s met every energy need through the hottest summer with our aircon, pool etc. Be sure to talk to the installers to confirm location and whats agreed, as they will take the time needed to talk to you and ensure expectations are aligned, to get it right. We barely noticed they were there after first chat and there wasn’t a spec of dust after install. Just looking at it you could see how precise it was. They were bang on time, respectful and just top lads. The after install customer service is also top quality. It’s a company built on proper values of quality and customer service. They will answer all your questions and assess your needs and deliver perfectly. The consumption monitor/app is next level and super intuitive. I’ve never understood my energy use better. We’ll be getting an electric car soon and 100% will engage Solaire Connect again. Couldn’t recommend them more.

Sales and quotation were very good. Roshann answered all my questions. Was very efficient. Didn’t denigrate other companies like one of the other sales people did and was on time pleasant and engaging, unlike the third sales person who was late, didn’t have what he needed with him, said he’d do things he did do etc. The pricing was all similar. The install seemed to go well except someone put a foot through my ceiling. Into my guest bedroom where I had a guest staying. They tidied up and put cardboard over the hole. I didn’t hear from anyone until til Tuesday, after that was a Friday. They fixed it on Thursday and Friday but I had to leave people I didn’t know in my house to get it done. Or I would have had to taken time off work and no one was offering any compensation for this issue. I was told to not pay. So I didn’t then was sent a reminder to pay. Then when I pointed a few things out they said they always give a $100 Bunnings voucher in these rare situations. That was incongruous with the statement of the lead installer who said it was the third time in recent installs. I had questioned him because he had his head in his hands and was muttering “not a third time” under his breath and I wanted to make sure that that was not a third thing going wrong at the beginning of my system install.  I wasn’t super happy about leaving them to finish the install but they did. 4 broken tiles no issue what so ever. Hole in my ceiling for a week and the room stinking of paint for a further week was. A late and coaxed $100 Bunnings voucher seems like a poor attempt at rectification. Now I’m stuck with these guys for the next ten years!! I just hope that nothing goes wrong. So far it’s going well.

The quoting process was excellent with all my needs being met and all my queries being answered clearly with detailed explanations. The sales consultant was very friendly and very professional in his manner of communication.  I was so impressed with the level of service and the quality of the products the company offer, I even referred my parents in purchasing a system.

From quote to installation, I have had the best service. Communications has been excellent. Battery installed today( held up by western power)  team arrived on time, answers any questions I had, help set up the Sonnen app , and place of installation left very clean

Sales person came straight to my home to run me through requirements and options. It's good to have face-to-face consultation rather than other emailing and quoting without attending the house.Installation went well. It was a tough job and took them an extra day and the heat was horrendous, but they got the job done very professionally.Customer service was great. Everything was organised for me.

Solaire have their own team of in-house installers. They arrived on time and were great to work with. Our system is up and running at the nominal rating. We had an initial problem with monitoring app but that was fixed quickly.

I couldn’t be happier with my  solar installation. The team was professional, punctual, and highly knowledgeable. From the initial consultation to the final switch-on, the process was seamless and stress-free. They took the time to explain the system, tailored the setup to suit my energy needs, and ensured all paperwork and approvals were handled efficiently. I’m already seeing the benefits on my electricity bill. Highly recommend this company to anyone considering solar!

We recently had a 19kW solar system installed by Capital Valley Solar, including a SMA inverter and a Stiebel Eltron heat pump. From the initial consultation to the final installation, the entire experience was smooth and professional.Kam from CVS was outstanding—his technical knowledge is impressive, and he clearly explained every step of the process. He was always available to answer our questions and made sure we understood how to get the most out of our system.The communication throughout the project was excellent, and more importantly, the job was completed on time, with no surprises or delays.We are very happy with the quality of work and the products installed. We highly recommend Capital Valley Solar to anyone looking for a reliable and knowledgeable solar installer in Canberra.
We were extremely satisfied with the entire process of our solar installation from initial contact, advice given, punctuality & workmanship. Thank you Paramount!

Paramount were recomended by Solar Quotes and a friend who had dealt with them. The entire process was stress free. They kept us informed throughout the process including a two day delay in installation due to severe storms in SE Qld.

Close to a year after these guys installed a 13.3Kw system, we realised it never uploaded more than 5Kw to feed in yet we had a 3 phase connection so it should have been uploading a lot more. When asked for help, these guys wiped they're hands of us saying it was an AGL issue. They would not help us at all. I'm unsure if they logged in remotely and reset settings in the inverter or not to fix it but the problem appeared to be resolved shortly there after. Obviously they had never tested the system at installation yet sent us "Buy A Solar Battery" Email every few months. I would not recommend dealing with Paramount Energy in any way shape or form. They treat clients as ATM machines. Nasty piece of work are they. Stay Clear.

From start to finish Pure electric provided best in class service.As someone that had 0 knowledge of solar and battery technology and blasé with our own power consumption, we have been shown the way of the future with Pure electrics experience.Everything ran smoothly and also ahead of quoted time. Flexible with solar array location and giving best system advice for full home backup.Experienced first grid outage recently and did not even notice a flicker or have internet drop out.

Tom provided a very detailed quote and came out to our site to check everything out before installation. Answered all of our questions arranged for old solar hot water panels and evaporative cooler to be removed.Installation. went smoothly. Tradesmen arrived on time. Explained all work. Set up and Showed me how to use the Tesla app for the battery.Organized grid connection and all paperwork. Checked the system is working from their end and even recommended a retailer with the highest feed in tariff. Worksite left clean and tidy.

I had an exceptional experience with Pure Electric Solutions from start to finish. The sales and quoting process was clear, honest, and incredibly informative — Tom patiently walked me through everything, even though I was completely new to solar. What truly stood out was their empathy and professionalism when I was involved in a serious accident and had to postpone the installation. They handled it with such understanding and flexibility, without any pressure. When the time came, the installers were punctual, polite, and left everything spotless. The system was explained thoroughly, and they even helped organise the grid connection and made sure I felt confident using both the solar panels and the battery. I can’t recommend them highly enough — I even recommended them to my brother who is now also getting a system installed from them!Pure Electrics is reliable, compassionate, and truly customer-focused.Sales/Quoting Process:Excellent — clear, upfront, and no pushy sales tactics. I had a lot of questions, and Tom patiently answered every one, making sure I understood how the solar and battery system would work, including options for future upgrades.Installation:Delayed due to a major accident I had — the company was incredibly understanding and rescheduled with zero hassle. When the install happened, the team was punctual, polite, and left the site spotless. They worked efficiently and respectfully.Customer Service:Outstanding. They not only managed all the paperwork and grid connection setup but also made sure I knew how to monitor and use the system. Their follow-up and support were top-notch.Overall:A genuinely compassionate and professional company. If you’re looking for a team that combines technical know-how with excellent people skills, look no further.

I use the AGL sungrow bundle as upper limit (6.6kw PV + 9.6kwh battery for 16500 based in SA) to compare with the quotes I received. Using the same sungrow components, most of the quotes are similar to AGL. I have only a few quotes came back with "reasonable" price. I checked the reviews from SolarQuotes + Google, and decided to go with Greenaus.Through the first phone call to the end of the installation. I can say I have no regret. I have my system installed on 09/12/2024, and it is currently running (only for 3 hours :-)).If you are in SA, it is definitely worthwhile to get a quote from Greenaus to help you making a informed decision.

The process was okay, installation was quick easy and straightforward. The prices they charge are ridiculous, and the interest they charge with payment plans is even more ridiculous. After putting down a deposit, I owed 5,400, and then needed to pay that back over a year. 18.52% interest rate with only a year of repayments. Absolutely shocked, but I had no choice as they had already done the install.If I could go back, I would have gone with another installer that gives much better value, and does the same job for a better price, or maybe no so high interest rates.Originally I was quoted 6,200 for a 9.6kw system with them saying confidently they could fit that many panels. After installation, they called saying they could only fit 8.8kw worth of solar panels. The discount for not fitting as many? $175. It cost 6,025 for the 8.8kw panels. However, they charged me $7,000 all up AFTER REBATES GO TO THEM for this 8.8kw system paid over just a year. Speechless.I was going to recommend this company to friends and family, as the installation was smooth actual solar panels and inverter all worked well, however, this pricing and interest rate is a robbery.

I had an amazing experience with this company. The customer service was outstanding, and the product was exactly what I was looking for. I was so pleased with the service I received from this business. They went above and beyond to help me find the perfect item.

The team at Instant Solar took care of our installation from start to finish. After receiving the quote, the team handled everything, including grid applications and the installation, which took about 2-3 weeks.Since the installation, we haven’t had to buy any power thanks to the system's size and the battery for our nighttime use.We’re excited to receive our next bill, which we expect will be in credit!

The quote and agreement on the best system for our needs was finalised on the same day we contacted Instant Solar.The installation team arrived as agreed on the day booked. They were punctual, polite and great to deal with. The old system was removed and disposed of. Extremely efficient, clean and tidy workers.Customer service has been amazing throughout the whole process. Everything was explained thoroughly, grid connection organised and monitoring app installed with their help.We would 100 percent recommend Instant Solar. We are so pleased we chose them to install our new system.
Amazing experience from initial quote to installation. All costs were laid out properly and price was reasonable. Flexible in getting it done even with bad weather. Personable team too

From the beginning Gavin made the whole process very smooth. He has an extensive knowledge of the industry and was able to explain everything well. He is very approachable and friendly.The installation went very smoothly and had no issues at all.Instant solar have a great customer service before and after the job was completed.Highly recommend this company.

All involved with the company were efficient with answering all questions and provided well executed installation and follow up care. Great customer service with the people I dealt with for the whole process from initial quotation, and continues with great follow up communication.

They are very nice, friendly, and did a good job, also helped with everything I needed to know, would definitely recommend to my friends to go to this company.I'm really satisfied with the recommendation of Solar Quotes.  Haven't got the battery yet. Maybe in the future. They even included a full cover for my inverter free of charge.
John was prompt and professional in there approach to the job at hand. John only lives 10 minutes away and said if I have any problems just give him a ring.

review_description: I would strongly recommend Mahoney and Da Silva to anyone looking for a solar and battery installation. We had a quite a few spells of bad weather, but they always took the opportunity to finish the job as quickly as possible when the good weather rolled around. review_description: This is the third system I've had installed, with both the previous ones being done by large/mid scale installers, and both were trouble free with a satisfactory process and outcome. This time around I decided to try one of the three referred by Solar quotes and I chose this small scale owner-operator expecting a more personalised and still trouble free process and more active customer service. I was keen to support a small developing business.The quote process was straightforward and David was happy to provide a number of versions as we worked through the options to deal with my own and council's requirements (heritage overlay). The installation was also relatively straightforward, after we had one agreed reschedule just before Christmas. It was completed after the holiday period over 2 days. Once completed I was advised about the need to connect the system to the internet on an ongoing basis, which was news to me and had not been raised before. We are low internet users and rely on a 4G Mobile Internet Device which meets all our needs. However the Goodwe inverter would not connect. To cut a long story short various attempts to connect the system using different equipment did not succeed. Over a number of months, including supposedly waiting for Goodwe to supply a new WI-FI Dongle, the customer service deteriorated to the point that David stopped responding to calls and messages. Eventually I resorted to calling Evan and he was appropriately responsive and made significant efforts to connect the system without success. Eventually I was left to contact Goodwe directly, which I did a number of times, with Evan also not returning my call. After a number of calls and following Goodwe's advice eventually the system connected, but it was still not exporting any power (I know the current feed-in tariff is insignificant, but that's not the point). Eventually, just a few weeks ago (in August) I assume Goodwe discovered the export problem related to the post installation paperwork not been completed. Suddenly I received advice from my distributer and retailer advising receipt of relevant paperwork from the installer, and soon enough as if by magic the system was registered and exporting - all the while not a word from the installer. Throughout the post installation process I was made to feel like a difficult hard to satisfy customer, when in fact it seems that the problem all along was incomplete documentation by the installer. And still not a call to explain the issue, it's resolution, let alone any admission of responsibility or expression of regret. On that basis I can't recommend this installer. Next time I will likely stick to an established reputable higher volume provider with an established customer service charter and a issue resolution process that works and is not person dependent.

review_description: I recently engaged the team from Empire Solar to add a BYD Battery, Fronius GEN24 hybrid Inverter and Fronius WattPilot EV charger to my 8.7kW Solar system.Empire installed my original 2.7kW solar system 8 years ago, which was further expanded by Empire again in 2021 adding an additional 6kW and a second inverter. My battery was installed as requested on 30th June and commissioned on 1st July 2025 - I must have been one of the first to take advantage of the rebates. I’ve been up on the roof and every part of the installation is high quality. The wiring and conduit is all correctly rated and the whole system has functioned flawlessly for the past year. As a direct result of this, there were a few surprises for the installers (and particularly the excellent electrician) which resulted in a few minor delays which could have been avoided if someone had come out to scope the job earlier. I got the impression that they were VERY keen to get good reviews and were trying very hard to improve customer service to achieve that. I have a Sungrow 10Kw hybrid, 3 phase Inverter and 9.6Kwh battery. The electrician helped me setup the Sungrow app on my phone and it has also worked flawlessly for this past year. They offer everything at the sale stage and when things go wrong they don’t want to deal with it.Please read the reviews and the experience of others with 1Komma5, I was promised that customer service had changed and went with them, I regret my decision.

Prior to the federal battery rebate, I received a quotation and promised  a price reduction based on the Federal battery rebate.After 1/7/2025, I contact the sales team and ask for a quotation revision. I have to call the head office to make a complain (through 2 to 3 different calls before I can get the refund.)This review is only to rate the certain sales's customer service and way of dealing with customer.I have not receive any product , so hence this is not a product review.

The quoting process was was good and the quote provided was accurate.The installation was quick and the team was punctual and friendly. Communication was good and was kept informed about start time. The system does not feed into the grid, the energy retailer is point to installer and installer to retailer. Sales process: quick, they provided useful information and returned my queries promptly.Installation: punctual, tidied up after they finished the work, tried their best to hide the conduit and cabling, were careful not to damage thew roof tiles.Customer service: returned  queries promptly, took about 6 weeks to start feeding into the grid.

Easy process.The person who quoted and the one who followed up were able to answer all my questions and followed up well in the installation and operation.The installers were efficient but lacked some communication skills.The system installed meets every expectation.

Quoting process was very easy and informative. Everyone was so helpful explaining everything so we could understand what would be entailed. The installer was on time, the guys were lovely, polite, very efficient and left our premises clean an tidy. Customer service is great. Organised with our energy supplier for the installation of the smart meter, which has been done. All round we are very happy with our choice of solar installation suppler.

I had obtained many quotes from different suppliers as well as different t configurations. Eventually settled on 30 panels, inverter and battery for my house on 3phase supply.Got a full electrical switchboard upgrade in the process as I still had old fuses and all circuits were not protected.The install was done days after agreeing to terms and a team of 4 came to do both the switchboard work and the roof work. The work was delayed by rain so didn’t quite finish up on the Friday afternoon but a couple of guys returned on Saturday morning to job. They were all polite and helpful. There was a small problem where one of the panel arrays looked to be not generating anything but this was rectified when the installer returned and found a connector not quite pushed home far enough to positively lock into place.I was shown the basics around the shutdown startup process along with the supplemental signage in and around the switchboard and inverter.I was given access to the monitoring app to observe system performance.I found by accident that the wrong inverter profile was loaded as it was causing he inverter to switch to standby in the middle of the day at times but once this was corrected, the problem has gone away.Pretty satisfied.

The entire process was seamless, we received a great price and installation was completed 2 days after by a guy that has been in the profession for nearly 20 years and it certainly showed he did great quality work and everything was finished in approximately 4 hours. The system is working well, however we are still unable to connect our phone to the network which is frustrating. Ive made contact a few times requesting a call to walk me through the process but still no response, apart from that everything else was a breeze.

From start to finish, the process with 1KOMMA5 has been excellent – definitely a 10/10 experience.Graeme was outstanding throughout – always available, great with follow-ups, and super accommodating with calls on the fly.Brent and Daniel, the installers, went above and beyond – even removing an old satellite dish and taking it to be recycled. That kind of initiative really stood out.When our batteries didn’t kick in due to a tree over a powerline late on a Friday, I called at 5pm and was amazed at the support. Area Manager Tommy got me in touch with Brent again, and together we manually sorted the issue. I was genuinely impressed that they took the call after hours and stuck with it until it was resolved.To me, that shows 1KOMMA5 doesn’t just stop at installation – they’re in it for the long haul, with real support when you need it.Cheers,Jimmy

Komma5 sub contracts installation to Enviro energy. There was some issues with a missing component that was not in the installation kit. It took too long to sort that issue out. The people from Enviro energy were engaging and helpful. System now in and all is well.

The Sales/Quoting process was straightforward and the Salesperson was attentive and responsive to my questions.I did raise concerns about their mixed reviews, but was assured they would take care of me and that I could expect a seamless & stressless experience……after all they are the major supplier and installer of Powerwall in Australia, or so I was told.The installation was a nightmare. Not great for warranty work when their product fails. We used 1Komma5 from a solarquotes recommendation, to install a 12.8kwh Sungrow battery and upgrade the inverter to a 6kw hybrid Sungrow inverter to our existing solar system.1Komma5 were great to deal with, no hard sell, all questions answered, great customer service.Install guys were great! Professional install, neat and tidy. really good job.

1Komma5, paid a Deposit last October 2024 for a Tesla Powerwall 2 and it's now February 2025 and it still hasn't been installed. At this stage I think we have lost our money. I don't really mind as long as I can let other people know how bad they are to deal with hopefully they won't have the dramas Im having with them.

The quoting was simple and efficient.The installers did a good job in very hot conditions. Courtney from; 1KOMMA5  customer service was fantastic, easy going with no question too small , polite, respectful, helpful , time bound and  organised.

-sales person was very good, i have asked for more batteries installation in the next few months!!-the installers did a fantastic, neat job and all were very courteous, did not leave until the job was thoroughly tested and working.

Fantastic sales service with all my questions answered and adjustments made as required. The process went quiet for a couple of weeks until I was contacted with an installation date. Everything was smooth from there with the installation proceeding on time and everything working as expected.

1KOMMA5 were great to deal with and were able  to install in the shortest time frame of the suppliers we engaged. They also price matched the cheapest of the quotes we had. Jordan on their sales team was particularly helpful and followed up right through to installation to ensure the timeframes we had stipulated were met by their service team.

Alexi looked after my car charger install. This increased price but really happy and now I can expand more appliances in future.

Darren and the team at STE solar were fantastic to deal with - we had our panels, inverter and battery installed by their team and we found them professional, courteous and happy to help in any way. We would highly recommend them to anyone in the area.

review_description: I recently had an 11 kW solar PV system with a 28.8 kWh battery installed by LECA, and I couldn’t be happier.
