Parth, the installation manager, coordinated everything perfectly, keeping me updated throughout. Brandon handled the installation with great professionalism — the work was neat, tidy, and well-explained.After-sales support has been excellent, with prompt follow-up and help setting up the monitoring app. I highly recommend LECA for anyone considering solar and battery solutions.

Mustafa and his team from Solar Merchants did a fantastic job with installing a 10 kW Jinko solar system with a 24 kW Sigenergy inverter and battery. Mustafa was pleasant to deal with and didn’t do a hard sell that other solar installers I got quotes from did. Would recommend Solar Merchants.

No complaints here. System works well.Had a problem with inverter after 4.5 years, Mustafa was brilliant. The inverter company sent a new inverter, that, unfortunately didn't work either. Mustafa got onto the head of the company and insisted they send the latest model. So I am a happy lassy.

Fantastic - all of the above. Extra credit for realistic advice through quote, underpromising and over delivering.Also hooked up hot water to heat preferentially, significant rewiring of switchboard (the solarquotes did not attend and at least one included new switchboard. Not sure now but I don't think any suggested the hot water option)Was a personalised quote and system and install met my high expectations
System sounds expensive but it was 2017

The installation process was professional fast and clean. Every step was explained in detail . Due to the number of technicians on the job the job was completed in just a few hours when I thought that it would take days.I also had a Tesla wall charger installed and that was a professional job as well.I cannot recommend this installer enough.I was very impressed.

Jackson and the team were great. The sales process went really well and they were patient with all of my ongoing questions. The price was very reasonable (slightly below some of the larger installers) and the installation happened as planned. The installation team were also very professional and tidy. Follow up service has been great as well, with Sungen being happy to answer any questions I have about the new system (I was very new to Solar).Happy to recommend Sungen. I actually recommended Sungen to my mother, who have also used Sungen to install solar and battery on her property.

Sungen provided a clear quote and tailored the system to my needs. The installation process was smooth and easy. I had a problem with one of the battery modules, and Sungen worked to fix it, but eventually swapped it out with a replacement. I therefore experienced the after sales customer care, and it too was great. Jackson, the owner, personally responded to my texts and calls and attended to things. I highly recommend Sungen.
Yes it was all installed well and very quick as well. Love the new system.

Liam from Sungen inspected our installation requirements and provided the most thorough quotation and feedback of all the suppliers considered. He was prompt to answer questions.The installation was done on time, to the day. Given the high demand for batteries and solar at the moment, I was pleasantly surprised that they were able to achieve this. The installers were clearly very busy but worked hard and to a professional standard. I also wanted to get our switchboard upgraded. They did this on the day, at a very competitive price.The whole installation is neat, tidy and professisonal. Trung did a great job explaining the monitoring app. He clearly takes great pride in the work he does. The system is working as expected, already reducing our power bills.I have no hesitation in recommending Sungen.

We recently had a 17.29kW solar system with a 40kW Sig battery installed by Sungen, and the whole experience has been excellent. After getting several quotes, we chose Sungen because of their professionalism, knowledge, and honest approach. Liam and Jackson were fantastic to deal with—no sales tactics, just clear advice and a straightforward plan.Laim took the time to explain the expected return on investment, timelines, which gave us confidence. The installation itself was smooth, quick, and hassle-free. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and delivered exactly what was promised. With our terracotta roof being complex, we were nervous about potential issues (some installers had turned us away), but Sungen handled it with care—only two tiles were broken in the process, which was a huge relief.Liam also made sure I understood how everything works, from the system setup to the savings we could expect. The monitoring app is simple and user-friendly, making it easy to track both usage and generation.Sungen exceeded our expectations at every step—professional service, quality installation, and total peace of mind.Choosing a solar provider is a big financial decision, and we’re very glad we trusted Sungen with ours.

Great installation by Sungen, The whole process was smooth from quote to install, really nice to see that they turn up in person to provide a quote.Installers on the day were super helpful and even fixed some items that were not part of the job.Overall a pleasure to do business with.

Sungen gave a great first impression right from the start, being the only one of the 3 Solar companies we contacted to even offer to have someone come out and do a site inspection as part of the initial quote process. In fact, they even suggested it, right off the bat. Another company I requested it, and never heard back about getting an inspection done.So not only did they see our tricky roof, but sent up a drone to take proper, measurable pics to get a much more accurate idea of what was possible for our roof, meaning no misleading ‘guesstimate’ quotes. They were the only ones to tell us we wouldn’t be able to get the size of system we initially wanted, without compromising on things and risking damaging the roof.In terms of pricing they were competitive and even beat the only other quote we were considering, so that, along with their initial first impression and more accurate assessment lead us to go with them.Install was all done in a day, ending with the battery all hooked up and working, and a quick demo of how the house doesn’t even notice being disconnected from the grid. Very handy since we had a planned outage in the street booked for later in the month, and as we work from home this means we’ll be unaffected. They set up the app for us and I’ve been monitoring things through the day, and gave tweaked the settings to ensure we charge up the battery if needed overnight.Overall, very happy with Sungen from start to finish. Recommended.

From start to finish, my experience with Sungen has been excellent. Howie came for a site inspection (even flying a drone to capture overhead photos) and took the time to clearly explain everything I needed to know about solar—how the system works, the installation process, and the savings I could expect on my energy bills.What stood out most was the transparency and professionalism. There were no hidden surprises or pushy sales tactics—just honest advice and a straightforward plan. Howie walked me through the expected return on investment, timelines, and even potential challenges, which gave me full confidence in moving forward.The installation was smooth, quick, and hassle-free. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and delivered exactly what was promised during the consultation—something that’s hard to come by these days.Sungen exceeded my expectations on every level: great service, quality installation, and total peace of mind knowing I made the right choice. If you’re considering solar, I can’t recommend them enough—you’ll be in very good hands!

The salesperson was responsive, engaged and sent through quotes for a number of options that I put forward. The quotes were competitive and the systems included all the features that I was looking for.The salesperson came for a site inspection, which included a drone flown up to take overhead pictures, but it didn't include a detailed solar path assessment or shade analysis. Whilst shading is an obvious issue at the site, the scale of the problem was not apparent in any of the quotes (even from other companies) and in reality, the system is only producing at around 40% of its max potential.After the quote was finalised, a small deposit was paid and installation scheduled. Then the Federal election was held and the Battery incentive was announced. After discussion with the salesperson, we split the system into two, with PV and EV charger installation first, then Battery after the incentive kicks in.The installation (carried out by experienced sub-contractors) was done professionally with no issues. They managed the complex roof without issue and even managed to squeeze in 2 additional panels.Once the battery incentive kicked in, an installation date was scheduled. However, a final price (after the new rebate) was never provided even up to the very last minute, which caused some frustrations. After escalations, a final price was agreed and installation went ahead without a hitch.The Sigen inverter, battery and AC EV charger operates very well together. The mySigen app is very flexible and allows granular controls of all components. Monitoring can also happen locally via Modbus (after turning it on in the Installer App, by the installer).At the end of it all, very happy with the system so far!

We recently had solar panels installed by Sungen and couldn’t be happier. This is the second time we have used them and the team was professional, friendly, and completed the job on time with no hassle. Jackson was very helpful in recommending the best solution for our house and worked with us to ensure the placement of the panels were where we wanted them to allow for future installation of some skylights.  Highly recommend Sungen for anyone considering solar!

From the moment I first reached out to Sungen, the entire process was seamless and stress-free. The initial contact was handled promptly and professionally, with the team taking the time to answer all my questions thoroughly, which gave me great confidence in their expertise. When it came to providing a quote, they were not only quick but also very transparent, clearly outlining all the costs and ensuring there were no hidden surprises.What really stood out was the team’s extensive knowledge and their flexibility in accommodating my specific requirements. They listened carefully to my needs, offered tailored advice, and made helpful recommendations that ultimately improved the outcome of the project. Their fairness in pricing and approach was evident throughout, making the decision to proceed with them an easy one.The installation phase was equally impressive. The installers were highly professional, and demonstrated great attention to detail. They managed the entire installation without causing any damage to my roof—remarkably, not a single roof tile was broken. Additionally, they were meticulous about cleanliness, ensuring that all work areas were tidied up before they left. They left everything in perfect order, which I truly appreciated.Overall, my experience with Sungen was outstanding, from start to finish. Their combination of professionalism, expertise, and customer-focused service makes them a company I would highly recommend to anyone considering similar work.

System is up and working well but installation was not ideal. Sales and quoting process was smooth and friendly. However the installation was not without its problems: Sungen were advised of the terracotta roof tiles and more care should have been taken with installation. At least 50 tiles were broken in the process of installation which meant I had to source additional second hand tiles as replacement at an extra cost to me  (even though I already had at least 20 tiles already on hand). I actually had to get up on the roof and replace at least 20 tiles myself. Of course the rubble of broken tiles were left behind and it was only after a few weeks that I was able to convince Sungen to come back and clean up. While I appreciate the tiles may have been brittle I don't think installation was approached in a very intelligent way. The panels had to be moved from the original planned installation position to one further back from the street which meant that shade become an issue. If I had to sum up the installation in one word I'd say: rough. It was all bit fast and furious even though some delays meant that installation took 3-4 days instead of the suggested one day.
Great service from the Sungen team. System seems to be performing very well so far. Will continue to monitor performance.
On the ball no con bs price, I'm happy

The sales representative was knowledgeable and had some good insights, and no high-pressure tactics.Adapt Energy were upfront about lead times and installation schedules. Had a few issues but these which were resolved without too much drama. Was mainly a result of the new process with rebates in NSW. Am very happy with the final result with Battery covering power usage so far.

They need to communicate particularly as I am spending over $16000

Very efficient service. Top quality equipment.  The installation team was great and explained what they were doing. Cleaned up after installation. Helped set up the Ap. That was required, just everything.
So happy we chose Adapt Energy for our solar and battery! The install was stress-free, the team was awesome, and it feels great knowing we’re cutting bills and using our own power.

Sales was brilliant as the quote could be updated in real time as we changed the configuration of the system. Fantastic customer service, thanks to Katie by resolving the issue on the battery installation. It’s a quite a drama but it’s a good thing is Adapt look after there customers. Thank you Adapt Solar

Inny, Liam and the team at Adapt Energy were absolutely fantastic to deal with throughout the entire process. From exceptional knowledge and guidance through the consultation, design and grid connection process through to strong relationships with installers of high quality, who were friendly and prompt, cannot speak highly enough of Adapt Energy for all solar and battery needs

Steve and Paul from Adapt Energy were great to work with. They provided a competitive quote using top rated panels and batteries designed to suit my needs. They helped to simply explain aspects I didn’t understand which made the process easy. Highly recommend.

First contact was with Joshua. He came out to the house to discuss the whole project. My experience with Josh was remarkable and essentially the reason I decided to proceed with Adapt Energy. My system was up and fully operational on day one of the battery rebate scheme. That's frickin efficiency on steroids!!!A huge 'shout out' to Gavin (Adapt Manager) for his assistance and Bronwyn (accounts).Thanks to Dylan Wright and his install team, Harry and Caleb of 'Wright On Electrical' who did a great job who put up with me just sitting there not lifting a finger to help with the entire install - they knew what they were doing.Very happy customer throughout. The battery and app are working extremely well. Thank you to all involved. Lee

The sales/quoting process was very good and they organised the grid connection for us with a good feed in tariff after installation which saved us a lot of work trying to understand how to do it.The installation was very good.  The installers were very polite, tidy and punctual and showed us how to use the Ap on our phones with patience when dealing with older customersWe chose 14 Aiko panels and a Sungrow inverter.  The reason we went with Adapt Energy was because they were cheaper than other companies quoting for the same solar system

Very neat and professional installation. Overall a very good experience.

Quote process went very well.Installation process went well, the guys were here when they said they would be, the grid connection was pretty much straight away and the battery is very slick looking and the app is amazing lots of figures and graphs, great usable information..
Excellent sales process, clear information and no pressure sale welcoming comparison to other providers. Happened also to have most competitive price in first quote.

Mark came to my home to quote me on solar panels. He explained everything to me and answered all my questions. I had another 2 quotes from other companies and 1 of the other quotes came in with a bigger and more efficient system.  It was hard to decide as the other company was fantastic as well. I ended up going with adapt energy as it was a bigger company, has after sales support, registered all my warranties, is local to my area and had the fronius inverter and amazing service. The only concern I have Is the Aiko panels as they are new but I decided it was worth the chance.The installation was faultless and the crew was amazing. I’m now eagerly waiting to see my next electrical bill!

The installation was excellent, but things aren’t so good at the moment. To me it seems that perhaps the power from my battery is being sent to the grid overnight, but of course I could be wrong and it might be a fault with my battery which is a Power Wall 3.Also I have noted that power production from my panels seems to drop off around midday.Regards ,Adrian

- Sales conversations were very easy and informative, with minimal sales tactics or pressure.- Installers did a fantastic job, were prompt, respectful and understanding of having young kids at home.- Great customer service
Just had system installed and monitoring performance. Sales process very good allowing options to be explored. Installation team very through and determined.

Sales process - excellent.Installation process - terrible. Problems ordering stock etc is fine but then lack of any communication about this led to a great deal of friction. Did not attend when they said they would.Customer service - Operations team was ok once involved to smooth over the problems with the local installer.
Steve is very professional, he helped me understand fully the ins and outs of the initially daunting world of solar. My local installer was on time and very tidy. I would recommend Adapt to others.

Hi Team,I would like to say a massive thank you for the whole experience, stress free and easy.The girls on the phone we're very professional and easy to talk to considering i know nothing about solar.  Gavin was amazing, he explained to me how it all works and sent the drone up to look at my roof to give me a real life shot of how it would look on my roof. Very friendly, super professional, very hard working and you could tell they love what they do as they didnt stop and are super proud of their work.The whole process was completed in less than 2 weeks, the easiest thing I have ever done.  Thank you again
Prompt responses at all times. The installation team were first class. Absolutely outstanding. Nothing was too much trouble. They were happy, tidy and friendly.

On both occasions I phoned Adapt Energy for quote to install a solar and a solar/battery system. Installation staff were efficient courteous and removed all rubbish from site(s).All discussions with Energy providers was done by Adapt Energy on my behalf.Tuition in operation of equipment was provided. I do find reassuring Adapt Energy's monitoring via internet.I would have no hesitation(and I have) recommending Adapt Energy
Good service, communication, covered all the paperwork, contacted all relevant agencies.Was the only company that GOT UP ON THE ROOF when quoting.More expensive than other quotes but worth it.

Very satisfied.

I called Variety and received prompt response and were going to send out an electrician when we realised it may have been a battery initiated problem.  Turned out it was.Even though the fault was nothing to do with Variety their phone support was excellent.How good post sales support is an indicator of how good the company really is and Variety are excellent.

I had Longi panels installed with a Goodwe inverter.Vividh explained everything to me in detail.Dilan from the operations team kept me updated throughout the job scheduling process.Their installer, Joseph, did a fantastic and clean job.They submitted all the paperwork on time, although Jemena took three weeks for the grid connection  which was beyond their control.The team followed up very promptly.The system is working perfectly.I’m very happy with their service.
Thanks Jordan for helping make the decision to go with you guys .Great work by Joesph and the team who did a wonderful job highly recommend.

I was all set to go with another provider. Jordan the sales person was excellent. Helpful in explaining things without the over the top sleazy sales pitch (we're helping you out etc, you have to sign with us, only we can do it properly) you can feel from other sales people. He was polite and answered every question I had. The price was the best of the three I got quotes from. The install occurred a week or so later, so quick turn around time. A note that Variety seem to be an aggregator, they order the gear and sub out the install. It was a little annoying they wanted to and did deliver the materials a few days before install, they are large and you need a safe place for these to be kept. The installers left all of their rubbish here, which I was not pleased with. The post install inspection took 3 weeks, which is completely unacceptable IMO. I was told usually a week from the installer, that then turned into 2, and at the 3 week mark I rang to complain again. The inspector came the next day. The 3 week wait post inspection with multiple follow ups put a real sour taste to the whole experience, it would certainly make me think twice about using them again in the future.The system itself has been great, the most I've generated is about 5-6kwh in one go, 20-25KWH per day. Given this is in a Melbourne winter, I think these numbers are great.

Although the sales and quoting process was quite good the service after that was disappointing. The initial contact with installer was positive but he could not complete the job on the day and it took a few phone calls to both him and the company for the job to be completed.  You had to leave messages with both as they did not answer the phone.  It took 2 weeks to finish the installation.  Finally after 1 month from date of giving the go ahead the is up and running.  Very frustrating.  I am happy with the system but not the company I purchased it from.

Great service initially with the sales team. Few hiccups along the way. But overall job has been completed and I am happy with the system. Slightly dearer than competitors but the sales teams service and knowledge gave me trust in their company.

Provider had a good knowledge about product and he explained all financial criteria to go through with solar Victoria to get VIC rebates. And explain all different brands in market according to fit to your pocket.Service was quick.

We installed a 13.2kW system with Longi panels and a GoodWe inverter. Installer Joseph and his team did a fantastic job, handling the tough two-story installation with great attention to safety.The entire process was smooth, and customer service was excellent from start to finish.I highly recommend Variety Solar.Vividh and his team are truly professional and reliable.Thanks to the Variety Solar.Specially thanks to VIVIDH and his Team.Regards,Foram Patel.
Watch out for connectivity as the supplier Variety Solar  and AusNet can not get it sorted.

The process was simple. Arctic Energy were extremely professional from the start. The quote process was so easy and prompt. The installation team were right on time and very polite.  They installed my solar with no fuss and left my property tidy. Customer service was faultless. Once installed,  they took the time to explain everything I needed to know. I couldn't recommend this company more.

Jeff was amazing to deal with! He came out to inspect the roof and discuss the options available to us to achieve the best results with a solar system. Couldn't ask for more!

review_description: Great company to deal with from the quoting stage - explaining what’s needed for what we want. The rebate process, the scheduling of the installation and the follow up commissioningWe were kept up to date the whole processCheerful staff in the office and polite trades on site

One of the few solar installers I spoke to that actually took the time to design and explain the solution that would fit our household needs as well as the rebates that were available to us. I'd definitely give them the 6 stars
Very easy to get a quote.Installers showed up on time, very polite and tidy. Install took about 1.5 hoursThey took all the rubbish and connected connected the linked the heat pump to wifi for me.

From start to finish, our experience with Six Star Plus was nothing short of exceptional. The sales and quoting process was smooth, transparent, and professional. I engaged KIK Electrics to install solar panels on my new build a couple of years ago.  From the outset they were exceptional, from the quoting process, through to applying for the solar rebate and loan.  When it came to installation Dante and his team were knowlegable, punctual and able to put me at ease straight away.  The fact that they had to come back twice, once to do the roughins and the other to install the panels was done without fuss was fantastic, considering the distance they had to travel.  Justin was more happy to answer my stupid questions and organise the comissioning of the system in a timely and efficient manner.  I highly recommend KIK for anything solar related. Thank you guys.

Had KIK Electrics recommended through this site. Went with them despite being more expensive than I'd hoped - had found cheaper services previously didn't really have super outcomes so hoped if I spent a bit more this time I might be better off. Absolutely no problems with the system as far as I can tell - seems to be working really well and we are not drawing from the grid at all. Problem is, we can't feed into the grid because KIK have not sent on the proper documentation to the energy provider. This means that we can't provide any excess energy produced into the grid and our system shuts down if production exceeds use and the battery is already full, which is a massive waste. Company won't reply to me now - massive red flag!!! I have also found out that our VicSolar loan has not been able to commence because they haven't sent the paperwork to them either, so something seems to be going wrong at that end of the business. Will be interesting to see if I can ever get this system feeding into the grid and how it will operate when at full capacity. At the moment, although a 11+kW system, I have never had it produce more than around 4kW at any time, as I can't export the excess. So, fair to say my experience with them has not been great. Having said this, their installation was fast and tidy, so nothing wrong with that side of things.

Two installers recommended by SolarQuotes were very punctual and close on prices quoted (the third was very slow). However, I selected KIK electrics who were not on the list provided by SolarQuotes but were on their list of reviewed installers. KIK electrics consistently had high scores (4-5) from reviewers and, importantly, zero poor reviews. A poor review can be 'flushed away' by an adequate installer response, but otherwise they just sit there and contaminate a lot of otherwise good work.One of two directors of KIK electrics, Justin, answered my phone call and was immediately on top of my requirements. Their quote was similar to the earlier two, and Justin made helpful suggestions about a modular BYD battery, and waiting to collect data from the Fronius inverter to see if we really needed to spend more on another module for the battery.The installation team of four arrived at 8am on the appointed day and worked till 6pm in 30+ degrees to get the job completed. Justin arrived the next morning to set up the monitoring system and install a (free) range extender. Justin also organised all of the grid connection details and has been happy to answer a few follow-up queries.

We had our solar system installed by KIK a couple of years ago and we were exceedingly happy, so we naturally turned to them for the battery / heat pump.  This is where we discovered their customer service is now so bad it's actively impacted our impression of the company to the point where we don't want them anywhere near our systems.We sent an enquiry trying to determine feasibility of placement since this would affect several other renovation projects.  We promptly received back an AI generated response and a full blown quote for equipment we did not request.We explained our situation again, and finally got a site visit / feasibility, which was then followed by another quote - then high pressure sales tactics. Endless calls during the work day which went unanswered due to the fact I was working, with no voicemails, more AI generated emails referring to things we did not agree to or discuss and finally a "do by X date"When we tried to find out more information about the quoted equipment...nothing.  We have still not heard a response. It's been a couple of months now and we have zero interest in doing any further business with this company.

As a tradie myself running a small business,  it's good to see other businesses going around who know what they are doing. Lumos Electrical was straight forward with good ideas, experience, confident in doing the job and  knowledgeable. Exactly what you need when you are unsure of things.  From the moment they finished, everything was up and running perfect. They were neat and tidy and answered all my questions. Definitely recommend them.

Damien came out to quote on a Solar Battery install. Gave me some great, no BS, advice and a very reasonable quote. Josh came out to do the install and has done a very neat and professional installation. Damien came out for the commissioning and to give me a run down of the app and how to manage the battery. Everything from start to finish has been well-managed with great communication and execution.  Would (and have) definitely recommend.

We would highly recommend Lumos. If we could give them more than 5 stars we would.From quote to installation and after sales service, we found Damien and his team to be outstanding, providing high quality service at a very reasonable price.Damien’s knowledge of the solar industry is exceptional and his advice on the best system for us took the stress out of decision-making and made the whole process very easy.We put in a 13.2kW solar system with a 10kWHybrid Inverter and 25kW battery. We also replaced our old (inefficient) solar hot water system with a heat pump (on Damien’s advice) and we are so happy with it.Josh, Issac and Logan did an excellent job installing the whole system. The quality of their work is outstanding and, as an added bonus, they are genuinely lovely young tradies – personable and courteous.We were particularly impressed with Josh. Not only did he spot a few issues with existing electrics (and fixed them), his excellent communication and customer service skills ensured we were kept well  informed and updated every step of the way.We were also very impressed with how clean and tidy the boys were and how respectful they were when entering our house – work boots off every time. Having had many trades through our house over the past 3 months, I can say that this level of care is uncommon, and very much appreciated.If you’re considering a solar system, or any electrical work, we strongly recommend going with Damien and his team at Lumos.

Lumos Electrical supplied and installed a battery and hybrid inverter for my existing panel array in Bulli NSW. Everything is working perfectly. I have not imported any electricity from the grid since the install, which was on time, very professional, tidy. Software app for monitoring production, battery status and imports/exports to grid is excellent. They removed the old inverter, I assume for re-cycling, and installed a smoke alarm and bollard as per regulations.They connected the wiring so the battery will power selected lights and appliances in event of a blackout.I can highly recommend Lumos if you want a quality battery system at an excellent price.

My initial contact was via phone to gain general knowledge of the overall Solar system we should install. Damien from Lumos Electrical Contracting gave me plenty of his time and I was very  impressed with his knowledge and common sense answers and approach to my queries. This was followed up by a site visit where he actually went onto the roof to confirm the space available for the panels which indicated more than could be assessed from Google maps. Neither of the previous two contractors went to this trouble.We installed 30 Aiko panels, a Sungrow 25kwh battery and a Sungrow 10kw inverter. I considered the quote very reasonable.The installation process went very well with a team of 5 initially that were all very polite and friendly as well as going about their work quietly, professionally and without fuss. They were all very particular about being tidy, didn't wear shoes in the house and cleaned up after they finished.I couldn't recommend Lumos highly enough. It was a real pleasure to have tradesman go about their work without any issues.

Very happy with service from Lumos installing a new 13kw solar system on our new home. Damien took the time to meet on-site before providing a quote. This allowed us to troubleshoot with the builder the best way to install, as builder had already installed gyprock making things a little trickier. Damien provided a prompt quote and then his team were able to get the conduit installed promptly just before Christmas so we didn't hold up the builder....subsequently installed the full system in the New Year and very happy with the job and service provided. Would highly recommend.

Excellent service throughout. Delivered the cheapest quote for exactly what we were after. They even installed the backup system that other vendors wanted to charge extra for. Looking forward to their return to install extra modules to the Sungrow battery

Sales/Quoting - initial quote took a few more days to arrive but was on the mark. No hidden costs. Quick follow up with queries. Explained complex issues well (as did others) and I liked that the sales guy referred tech Qs to their tech guy if he didn’t know the answer (ie. didn’t take a guess). Initial quote was site unseen but I provided a lot of info in my brief.  Tech guy did a follow up site visit before install and before any money changed hands to double check no issues. Appreciated that he spent quite a bit of time with us going through questions.Install - guys on-site were competent, qualified, polite, communicative, tidy and careful.Follow-up - They sent through all paperwork immediately. They sent applications to Energy Australia to upgrade our switch board. They managed the rebates process. They helped me install the app and made sure it was working. They responded to follow up Qs immediately, throughout whole process.

The crew turned up on time and did an awesome job. They also left the place neat and tidy.I've got the opportunity to see a finished installation as reference.Customer service after installation and support is brilliant
The installer was very communicative promptly answering all my question, quality of the install was impeccable
Amin was very helpful and install team was great, on time and tidy

After a disappointing experience with the installer who originally fitted my solar panels three years ago, which I initially considered using the same company for my solar battery installation to keep everything under one provider, I decided to explore other options.Following an initial call with a Level electrical representative and sending my electrical for the last few months, I was scheduled an appointment with electrical designer Amir. He provided me with a much better package, helped rationalise my purchase based on my actual needs, and offered clear, sensible advice.On installation day, everything went according to plan. When I had a question, Amir personally called to explain things in detail. The communication throughout the installation was excellent, and the work was carried out neatly and professionally.The follow-up after installation has also been outstanding, with remote monitoring support and practical advice on balancing my energy usage.Initially, I was hesitant to sign up with Level Electrical given the limited reviews available on SolarQuotes, but I can honestly say I am very pleasantly surprised and impressed so far.In contrast, my original installer, EISS, showed little to no planning for the system at all and I felt was favoured for asking questions. They took an instalment payment in mid-May for a July installation (with the rebate), held onto the money for few weeks, then eventually returned it after saying they weren’t sure about the system. Later, when I approached them again, they had no issue to install the very same system they had rejected—this time with an extra $2,000 added, saying: “Sorry mate, prices have increased.”

How was the sales/quoting process? Absolutely excellent, simple, efficient, turned up on time, delivered information in a timely manner in plain English.How did the installation go? tuned up on time with a bunch of staff, they worked through the rain to get the install done in 1 day.How was the customer service? so far, great

Couldn't be happier with the whole process from quote to installation.Nic is very knowledgeable and offered options for the best solution for what I wanted to achieve.The team who did the installation did a fantastic job it what I would say was not any job. They worked together as a team was also impressive.Very satisfied customer.

Had to chip the sales person regarding "whole has backup" - after deposit paid he said that it was not possible but all documentation received said that it could be done - some compromises made.Grid connection (3 phase) was done by company with no real issues.Installation was professional.After one week operation, had a query regarding minimum battery drawdown and this was done promptly and remotely.The information provided on the app is fantastic and has allowed me to adjust the timing of the hot water system and pool pump to suit maximum solar production.

I am thoroughly disappointed in service as my solar has stopped working and IKOMMA (as it is now) have not been at all supportive. This morning I was told that as my system was installed 5 years ago that the only thing covered under warranty would be wiring components. Unbelievably they now suggest I phone another solar installer to attend to my solar. I have a large system and expected much better back up service.

I contacted Clayton Solar about installation of a solar battery. A quote was provided with explanation of various sizes and which one would be the best for us. From quote to instillation they were professional and helpful with any questions that i had. Totally recommend Clayton Electrical.

review_description: I chose Clayton Solar & Electrical to install my system a few years ago; because of their friendly customer service, helpful professional advice in choosing the right product/s, and competitive quote. They went on to impress me further with a seamless installation by a friendly team, and by helping me to navigate the steps required for my energy provider, connecting to Wi-Fi, using the app, and much more. Since then, Shane has provided ongoing technical support & advice anytime I’ve needed it over the years, including prompt advice on how to safely isolate the system after recently suffering major storm damage.So when this storm damage meant I needed a replacement system, I was understandably concerned that the building company managing my repairs was intending to assign their own solar installer to do so. I didn’t want to lose my preferred solar support team! After explaining this to the building supervisor, he agreed to onboard Clayton Solar to do my new installation, for which I am incredibly grateful.My second installation by Clayton Solar went as smoothly as the first, including the post install support again. I love that most of the team was the same as the first time, a sign that it must be a great place to work too, and Tim even went above and beyond by cleaning storm debris out of my garage for me before heading off (it was still full of leaves and dirt from the storm).Reading positive reviews lead me to Clayton Solar in the first place, so I hope this one helps you to choose too. I can’t recommend them highly enough, and of note I have since received thanks from my repairs building company for the referral… it seems they are so impressed by the team that they are already seeking their services again.Thank you Shane, Tim & all of the team at Clayton Solar.

review_description: The sales process was very informative and easy after I changed my mind several times. As they still had the same senior staff were always going to be in contention  for this job.It is hard to rate whether it was value for money as Sigenergy is a new product which has not had a chance to prove its worth yet despite the expensive price tag yet, so I am guessing a bit and could only rate 4 out of 5 for that reason.The job was started on time exactly when first scheduled and as expected they didn't let me down. All the guys on site were quality people, friendly, well mannered and very easy to speak to.The workmanship was of the highest quality again, the office staff organised all of the paperwork and set things up for the grid connection, the whole process went very smoothly and I am extremely happy and highly recommend Clayton Solar. You will definitely not be disappointed!!!
company_name: Clayton Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd

review_description: My experience with Solar Galaxy has been nothing short of a nightmare. Before making the deposit, their team was incredibly responsive and friendly—answering all my questions promptly and giving me a sense of confidence in their service.However, everything changed the moment the deposit was made. I sent numerous follow-up emails over the course of a month, and not a single one was answered. No updates, no timeframes, no acknowledgment—just complete silence. It felt like they vanished the moment they received my payment.This kind of behavior is not just unprofessional, it's deeply concerning. I trusted them, and they completely ignored my queries without explanation. I would strongly caution others to think twice before engaging with Solary Galaxy.

If you're thinking about going with Solar Galaxy, think very carefully. The install went fine, sure - but the real nightmare starts AFTER they’ve taken your money. Good luck getting any sort of help if your system has a problem. Their post-install service is non-existent.Communication horrible. Emails ignored. Phone calls? They will answer the phone sure, but they just lie about everything and it's empty promises with every conversation. Every time you chase them, it feels like you're starting from scratch.It’s like they ghost you the second they finish the install. No ownership. No accountability. Just silence and frustration. Oh but they do harass you post install to provide them a 5 star google review which I did but have now updated.I wish I had never gone with them, and I’m warning you now - if anything goes wrong with your system, you’re on your own. review_description: After briefing, receiving written proposals and evaluating five local Solar PV + battery installers, we chose Oslec Energy as our preferred option. My wife and I have not regretted this decision.Three of the criteria in our written and verbal brief was our insistence on someone coming to do a site visit at our home and not solely reply on satellite imagery to determine our individual requirement. Another important criteria was for an installer understanding our intent, system performance expectation and our power needs into the future. The final criteria was being able to supply and install quality kit within our reasonable budget.On all counts, Oslec Energy met these. Their personable Managing Director conducted the site visit, after having first read our written brief. He evaluated our shading issues, roof area and location for the inverter and storage battery. He went off and designed and priced a system specifically for us and our location. We now have a solar PV / storage battery system correctly specced and adequately sized for our current (semi-retirement) and future needs (full retirement) which now is a fully electric household including our BEV.The install team were friendly, efficient, professional, respectful, polite and did a neat install. On commissioning the set up, to be expected, there were a few early teething issues. With the help of Oslec, each were resolved. We now have a 13.2kW PV, 10kW inverter and 20kWh storage battery system working well for us.We have confidence in Oslec Energy being there into the future to support us should any issue or warranty claim arise. We could have purchased a similar system for less from other vendors, but as the old adage states - long after the price is forgotten, the quality remains. If you are looking to install a new or upgrade an existing system, we recommend you consider Oslec Energy as one of your options at least.

Jaryd and Simon are great guys willing to explain how things work and always there if you have any questions after installation.

During the sales process, Jaryd from Oslec was patient and guided us through the different options available. He provided us with a range of solutions suited to our needs, all at competitive prices.The installation was on a really hot day but the Oslec team cracked on, keeping their good humour under the most gruelling conditions. The end result is great - both the solar panels and inverter meticulously installed.After sales service kept up the standard. We were given documentation on use and maintenance, and are able to access the portal for our plant status on our phones and laptop. As we work from home that means we maximise our benefits by timing our use of high use appliances like washers, dryers etc for when our system is producing maximum power. The GoodWe inverter hasn't missed a beat, and the Aiko panels cope with shady conditions better than I expected.Overall, Oslec Energy exceeded expectations. It was an exceptional experience - would definitely recommend this company.

Okay I’m revising my original review of Stag Electrical. The reason is while my angry rant made me feel better it wasn’t particularly helpful to others. I now recognise Stag was incredibly naive and unrealistically complacent rather than necessarily incompetent. And I have to accept that more assiduous work on my part may have helped to avoid the shambles this became.Just a recap: I sought quotes through SolarQuotes near the end of April 2025, and received 3 referrals. I ordered a Powerwall 2 and paid the deposit to Stag Electrical in early May. This was to be the second Powerwall for my system. No other battery (including other Tesla batteries) was compatible. If I failed to secure a Powerwall 2 then I was stuck with a substandard solution for the foreseeable future. Tesla ceased production of Powerwall 2s in 2024 and old stock was rapidly disappearing. On top of that the federal government had introduced the battery rebate! And in Canberra there were rumours that the government interest-free solar loans were going to cease on 30 June (which in fact did occur); while I wasn’t getting a loan this promoted even more demand for batteries. This was the proverbial perfect storm and to say it made me nervous is an understatement.I contacted all who quoted and expressed my concerns about my fear of Powerwall 2s disappearing in the frenetic buildup to the start of the federal battery rebate. They agreed with me and said they would bring  a Powerwall 2 into their stock as soon as I paid the deposit. One reason I am modifying my review is that I can’t recall Stag Electrical making that specific undertaking. I had assumed anyone who worked in the industry as long as Stag would do the same as other suppliers and physically secure the stock. But I don’t recall explicitly asking for this. My bad number one.I still think Stag could have, with minimal effort, secured a Powerwall 2 battery rather than rely on reserving one with a wholesaler who was obviously going to be under immense pressure to satisfy an unprecedented demand for stock to desperate installers. Just about everyone in the industry had predicted this. And Powerwall 2s were special in my case because I could not expand my system with any other battery.The second area where Stag let me down was implying my Powerwall was available in each of my follow-up phone calls. They were even offering assurances to me in June, although apparently now saying they found out (in July admittedly) that Powerwall 2s ceased to be available in May. I accepted those undertakings, again based on my previous dealings with Stag and SolarQuotes endorsement of them. My bad number 2.So on 1 July I was waiting for the call from Stag to tell me when my installation would occur. The call I got on 14 July was that Stag could not source a Powerwall 2 even though they had been trying for the past 2 weeks. I was not a happy camper to find out that not only had they not secured stock but had also been giving me assurances for the past 2 months that everything was on track. I may have overreacted a little.While the result was initially devastating for me, I have to concede that I could have been more explicit and rigorous in keeping Stag on track, and have to accept that.I still think Stag should have, as an experienced operator in the industry, done more to secure a battery without the need for a customer to constantly hassle them. But lessons learned.Just because an installer has provided good service in the past there is no guarantee they will continue to do so.SolarQuotes endorsement of an installer is a low bar and due diligence requires much more than relying on that.

I requested six proposals for my solar upgrade and received six different solutions.  Several were clearly cookie cutter one size fits all proposals that got binned immediately, one didn't even listen to the brief,  then there are the installers who hear the basics then jump in before hearing the detail - Note to installers, if you can't be bothered even listening to what the customer is trying to achieve, what is the likelihood of them getting the solution they want?  This is where Greenline Solar stood out and secured my business.  During the development stage, Toby listened to what I wanted to achieve beyond basics of capacity, came up with a solution, put it to me to scrutinise, I got to ask questions that sometime required research on his part and eventually a shortlist of three proposals for me to choose from.  It was this level of collaboration, patience and commitment that got my signature.  Every part of the system could be qualified and justified.  Initially I thought I'd get a few quotes and boom job done, but the research phase took a lot longer than anticipated and I wouldn't change that because the result is fit for purpose.  After the groundwork  is done, the install is easy and the result is all but guaranteed.Jake and his install team turned up as planned, on time and worked like champs on what was in places a challenging install.  They asked questions rather than making assumptions, ran to schedule and cleaned up after themselves.  What more could you ask?If you take away one thing from this review it's this.  Any installer can install whatever panels, inverter, battery etc you spec based on your research or their opinion, then walk away - tick the boxes and away they go.  For some this is ok.  What you will get from Greenline Solar is that extra effort, time, commitment and integrity.  I'd use them again in a heartbeat and recommend them without reservation.

System: 39x Jinko 440w panels, 10kW Sungrow inverter, 12.8kWh Sungrow modular battery.When looking for quotes,  I spoke to several companies, and decided o go with Green Line Solar as they had really good pricing and speaking to Toby was straightforward and easy. He spoke in a way that was to my level of understanding and gave me a few different options, which was exactly what I was after. Green Line Solar handled most of the paperwork, with only Solar Victoria (for rebate, loans) needing to be done by myself online. The install was originally scheduled for early Feb the following year, but due to a supplier stock issue for a different brand, they were able to move up my install before Christmas, and I got some bonus STCs!On inspecting the house, Jake identified the best position for the inverter and battery, which happed to be where an old broken gas ducted heater was situated. He organized for a plumber to come out to disconnect the gas line and remove the heater. As part of the install, Jake provided concrete slabs and a cement sheet to cover the hole in the wall from the heater. The install happened over two wet days, and Jake and the guys on the roof took care to replace tiles each time it started raining. They kept me informed of when they needed to turn off the power, and kept that to a minimum. The install is very neat and tidy, the cable runs immaculate. Jake performed all the electrical checks, explained the changes to the switchboard, and introduced me to the Sungrow iSolarCloud app.I am very happy with the system, and all my dealings with Green Line Solar. Highly recommended!

My Enphase PV system and Tesla Powerwall 2 battery was sold to me by Solarworx and installed by Thoroughtec around 2020. An initial 9.6kW PV system was installed followed shortly after that by a Tesla Powerwall 2 battery. Additional panels were installed in 2022 to bring PV system up to 14.4kW- Installation by Adrian at Thoroughtec was professional and I can't fault the installation.- before the system was installed Solarworx requested that I put up a review of the installation before it had actually been done. It seemed like a strange request at the time but in good faith I did so. That review has since been taken down at my request.- During a prolonged outage my system went fully offline. I had been led to believe that the system was configured to charge the battery from one third of the PV panels during a grid outage. Upon inquiry to Solarworx they told me that Tesla systems had been shut down by Tesla on orders from SAPN. While servicing the system at a later date the technician informed me that the battery didn't charge during the blackout because the system hadn't been configured to do so.- During installation of the Tesla battery two CT sensors were removed from the Enphase system and went missing. Inquiries to SolaWorx as to the whereabouts of the missing CTs (I paid for them) were met with evasive answers. During one phone call with the director they assured me that they had the CTs sitting on the car seat next to them as we spoke and they'd be delivered that day. They never turned up.  I eventually received 2 CTs in the mail after several emails and texts.- During the adding of the additional panels mapping of the extra panels on to the Enphase system was not done. I never got a straight answer from either Solaworx or installer as to why this hadn't been done. After several requests to Solaworx to get the mapping done I approached the installer directly and they eventually mapped the panels.- In late 2023 a repeatedly tripping battery isolation circuit breaker was traced to a melted battery AC harness connector. I paid a service person to trouble shoot the problem after being told there'd be a 15 day wait by Tesla before the problem could be looked at. I made Solaworx and Thoroughtec aware of the issue via email. Heard nothing back from Solaworx but got a response from Thoroughtec.- In early 2024 an intermittent issue with the neurio meter started occurring. I didn't bother attempting to get the issue resolved by Solarworx based on my experiences with them up to that point. Since then I have been trying to get the issue resolved via direct contact with Tesla, and via Thoroughtec....so far with no resolution.- to his credit Adrian at Thoroughtec has tried his best to help me out even though the onus should be on Solarworx to resolve my issues. I can't fault the installer.- My advice to anyone considering PV or a battery...only deal with a company that does the actual installation. Avoid doing business with salesmen who then subcontract out the installation to other parties. Overall my experiences with Solarworx were very disappointing and I wouldn't recommend the company to anyone.- I see a number of glowing recent reviews from people who have had Sigenergy systems installed by Solarworx. Good luck and hope you don't have any issues with those systems. If you have any issues theres a high chance you will like me end up having to deal with the equipment manufacturer and/or the installers.

I am writing to raise several serious concerns regarding the installation and service of my solar system completed by Aussie Hybrid Solar (AHS).1. Incorrect Inverter ConfigurationOur property has a three-phase power system, but AHS team installed two single-phase inverters. This setup caused one phase of our home to continue drawing power from the grid. Their response stated that the use of two single-phase inverters complies with Australian electrical standards and installation requirements, and that I may consult a third party directly. However, compliance with standards does not automatically mean this configuration is appropriate for my system design or usage needs. The installation outcome clearly indicates an imbalance and inefficient utilisation of generated solar power.2. System Activated Before Meter ReplacementAHS team turned on the solar system immediately after installation, before the new smart meter was installed by the energy company. I specifically confirmed with their staff at the time whether it was okay to use solar power right away, and was told “yes.” However, I later discovered that my solar production was feeding into the grid without being recorded, meaning I was effectively sending power to the grid for free while still being charged for grid electricity. This caused my electricity bill to increase significantly instead of decrease. I am uncertain about the exact regulatory requirements, but I believe this practice is improper and misleading to customers.3. Failure to Address Off-Peak Controller ConnectionIn my switchboard, there is a main switch and an off-peak controller located together. AHS installers did not consult me regarding whether I wanted to remove the controller and connect it back to the main switch. They only connected the solar system to the main switch. As a result, part of my home’s electricity usage was excluded from the solar system, continuing to draw power from the grid. I was unaware of this issue until another company came to install a battery and pointed it out.Although I am still within the five-year warranty period, AHS company has repeatedly emphasised that their responsibility ended after installation. I have experienced unprofessional service and poor after-sales support. AHS staff advised me to contact an “authorised third party” to provide evidence, yet they did not specify who this third party is. They also ignored the issues raised by my licensed electrician.Due to these unresolved problems, I have lodged a complaint with NSW Fair Trading and will now have to organize a qualified electrician at my own cost to correct the installation issues.

review_description: Josh from Zeco met with me and took on board my slightly unusual requirements for the installation:I didn't want any information about generation or consumption going from the inverter to the grid operator or the inverter company.I also didn't want any organisation to have the ability to switch off the system without my permission.I still wanted to be able to access consumption and generation data within my home network.In fact, I wanted to operate the whole setup without any internet connection or account with the installer or anybody else.On the first two requirements, Josh and Zeco were able to set me up with a Sigenstor inverter.  They checked with SigEnergy to make sure it could be operated without an internet connection, and that it would still be covered under warranty.  This is not the way the usual install goes, but they were able to accommodate my requirements.I chose not to receive a feed-in tariff so as to avoid becoming part of the "backstop", as that would have enabled the grid-operator to turn off my system if they felt like it.  The feed-in tariff is low enough now that I expect to make my money back by saving electricity instead of exporting it.It took a bit of close coordination with their electrical engineer (thanks again Janak) to enable MODBUS to scrape the usage and generation data via WiFi, but that works well now and I have integrated it with my home server.I have an old house providing challenges in situating the inverter and the battery while adhering to planning codes, but the panels and inverter/battery were nonetheless installed very professionally in a single day, and it looks great.  Neat work, and the panels and inverter/battery combo themselves are good-looking imho.TLDR good looking, installed in one day, and good communication.

review_description: All quotes were similar, including one I sourced independently. I went with Zeco because Josh from sales was the only provider (aside from the one I sourced myself), to actually visit the property. Josh was also the most helpful in the myriad of questions I had, as this process does not seem to be a straight line. Zeco was able to deliver the system that I had settled on, with the other providers being set on the product they were “selling”. Whilst this was probably true for Zeco as well, the combination of all the above, was decisive.The only “complaint” I would have, is that once past the sales stage, I would have preferred to have been referred to a “project manager” that would be present at the day of installation, and any subsequent follow up. The day before the installation I thought that I had that when someone came to assess the site, but I never saw him again. I had to request “a favour” a second time when the installation crew arrived in the morning. I had to source “replacement tiles”, for which the colour of roof tiles are no longer available, but I had a match otherwise. I asked both if it was possible to switch out those tiles for what would be underneath the panels, and both said “no problem”. It wasn’t done, so that is a minor disappointment.Otherwise, the installation crew did an excellent job, and were clean and tidy.After installation I noticed on the Enphase app, that the panel array map had not been uploaded. I had to revert to Josh once again, who was able to follow up and rectify that. Without a project manager, I don’t know if that was an expected thing, or an oversight on the day. The crew was done in a day, and I sensed that this was a tight schedule. Previously, I was told that it would take a day and a half.Follow up with the inspector was good, and that occurred a few business days later, but there has been no communication coming from our energy retailer as yet. When we contacted them they said they have not received anything from Zeco (at that point) and provided “correct” email addresses to forward to the company. After we did so, we were advised that we needed to wait for the energy retailer to contact us, or wait until the next bill. A month later and I’m none the wiser.There was a billing kerfuffle when the “final invoice” came, being $2,000 over the quoted price. Once again I had to contact Josh, who was able to get that rectified a few days later. However, I suspect that this may have been a complication from the VicSolar rebate. The installer scanned the barcode VicSolar had sent me, but I had to email that sometime after the installation to yet another person (who I presume works in their accounts).All up, satisfactory. But as with any complex trades business, there are always “complications”.

Andrew outlined the display features of the battery and helped us with the App setup and capabilities. We would not hesitate recommending them to anyone looking for Solar installations.

The entire process was seamless. From the initial review, quote process and installation, it was very smooth and met the expectations provided by AHE. They arrived on time, everything was well installed, and they provided an in-depth training on the various apps required. I would recommend them to anyone.

AHE Group suppliedand fitted our first solar panel systemin 2011. We have just had them upgrade our system to an 11.88kw with battery and its brilliant. Their sales and install team are excellent to deal with and I would definitely recommend them.

Couldn’t have been any happier and the system has operated absolutely flawlessly since then.So when the battery rebate kicked in. I called AHE again and asked them to quote me on an appropriate system. I must say the whole process from design, to quoting to install was deadset flawless. Not only does Andrew and the team know their products inside out but they apply real world use for their installs.Ended up with the Sigenergy Sigenstor 48kw system, an increase of 11 kw of panels and the accompanying Sig EV charger.Install was flawless and efficient. Completed in a day with a full rundown of the product along with answering a plethora of my questions. Not to mention the little added extra surprise of the included automation of some external power devices which I had no clue was even possible!I am deadset wrapped with the install and my new shiny battery!Thanks again to Andrew and the team at AHE!

Andrew Hanna gave very detailed advice about where we could install a solar battery in our terrace, and recommended Sigenergy as the best option for the space we had.The install was completed cleanly and effeciently, with attention to detail that everything was working as expected.I used AHE previously to install our solar system years ago, and they have always been flexible and ready to help. I think their longetivity speaks to the quality of the work and the customer service they provide.

Andrew installed my first solar system around 13 years ago. I had no hesitation in asking Andrew to provide a quote for a battery and solar system to replace the original. Altogether professional good communications and could not ask for better service.

Wow…… what a great experience. Andrew, Leanne and their crew knew their stuff. From the initial call through to install, I knew I was in good hands. They gave a very competitive quote and answered all my numerous questions throughout the entire process without any hesitation, annoyance or eye rolling. On the day of install, Andrew and Sam (Andrew’s son)  were able to redistribute the solar panels on the roof to optimise a greater solar yield and even threw in an extra panel free of charge.After the installation was completed, Andrew showed me how to use the app and also went through a blackout scenario to ensure the system was working properly.I live on the NSW Central Coast and was originally going to go with a local installer however, I would not hesitate in recommending AHE group for any solar and battery installation. Their professionalism was next to none. Thank you

Andrew and team installed our first small system in 2011. It's still going strong. Last Thursday they commissioned our 13kW Jinko array with 48kWh Sigen battery. They arrived at 8am, as promised, and it was up and running by 1pm. The guys take great pride in their work and managed to hide all cables (panels to battery, battery to gateway, gateway to board). The panels from 2011 were cleaned off and the old inverter was plugged into the AC input of the gateway and now provides about 1/7 of total generation. I did get another 3 quotes from Solar Quotes but Andrew was given the job not just because we had worked with him before, he was also the cheapest and did not oversell. (In fact he suggested I get a new car before getting a charger.)  Also, great to work with the same person all the way through (avoiding miscommunication). Better clean up than most tradies we've used. Helpful advice too. For example, I plan to move to Amber (without Smartshift) and he suggested playing with the gateway's various "modes" and get to know these before moving. I have since discovered I can also create my own modes!

Andrew inspected our premises and reviewed our electricity bills before providing a quote for a tailored, recommended package. The quote was slightly higher than the next one, but in-house tradesmen installation was perceived to be less risky.The date was set, was met and the installation by Sam and Anthony was efficient and clean. The battery was already 40% full on activation at 1:00pm and 87% in four hours.Our first night was like heaven! Lights, fridge, everything run from the sun and not the grid. What a great result!AHE was recommended to us by our sparkie, and I can recommend them to you.

Highly recommended.

Also showed me how to monitor the usage on app. It’s been about three months now and my power bills have dropped heaps. Couldn’t be happier — highly recommend these guys if you’re thinking about going solar!
From start to finish we were happy with the service Andrew provided. Great value and efficient install.
Andrew was upfront and honest with the plan for my job and asked what I wanted from my system. Andrew and his team were friendly and punctual, with a neat and tidy solar and battery install.

While this approach could mean waiting a little longer for installation (I only waited less than a month), I think knowing what quality you are going to get is worthwhile.As a former architect, I also appreciate that AHE is meticulous with paperwork—quotes, contracts, and certifications are all handled thoroughly and building standards are strictly adhered to with no corners cut.Overall, AHE delivers professional, high-quality service with a personal touch. I highly recommend them.

Great working with Leeanne, Andrew and the team. This is the second install on a different property in the last 10 years, and still an amazing team.Work was very professional, punctual and no mess left onsite. Andrew is a pleasure to deal, well done

It was pleasure to work with Andrew and his team.The quote was comprehensive and thorough. Several revisions with several options were offered. Onsite inspection was important part of choosing the most appropriate option and allowed to ask questions / discuss installation/ positioning of the battery, panels, etc.Installation was completed on scheduled day by 3pm. Punctual. No nonsense. Arrived prepared and with sufficient resources.Excellent installation quality - no visible cabling. All equipment looks like it was meant to be there.

I had my first solar installation years ago with this group and was very satisfied with them. When I started looking for installers this year, AHE Group were still in business, with the same Director and, later realised, an electrician of the old crew. I did receive a few quotes from other installers to cross check the situation and at the end had no hesitation to proceed with the offer from AHE Group. A long-established Company is no doubt a very good indicator of professionalism and commitment.I discussed a couple of alternatives with Andrew (the Director) and agreed to a solution just after the NSW Government decided to withdraw funding for the batteries rebate.As soon the Contract was signed, I was given the installation date of 15 August. Despite the crappy weather we had in Sydney for the last few weeks, they confirmed the installation day 48 hours in advance. I was really surprised because it was really raining a lot during the prior days.On the installation day I was working from home as I was very interested in following the steps of the installation and the approach in general. It did go as I remember went the first installation: a dedicated group in charge of the panels (removal of the old and install of the new) a second with the battery and a third with the switchboard.Andrew came early on to define the location for the panels and the battery and make sure everything was at hand. The crew was managed by Sam every time it was necessary but were mostly self-sufficient. Sam also tried hard and succeeded to embed all the wiring within the double brick cavity, so in the end the installation looked very, very nice. Managing a thick 3x16 + 1x6mm2 cable is difficult in these cavities. To my engineering mind, the work was above level in all aspects, from using the right tools, materials and methods to the finishing presentation.At the end, when the crew was cleaning and packing all the leftovers and rubbish, Andrew came back to check and certify the installation. I had no doubt that everything was in order as I followed the process during the day. Everything was OK first go, with and almost ridiculous number of labels everywhere and with a new set of MCBs in the switchboard.I have many more details that I liked about the whole experience, but it may be too long to describe here.To conclude, I have no hesitation in recommending AHE Group because they were very good in all aspects of the solar installation.
Overall I was very happy. The install was quick and clean The staff were very friendly and professional. The only thing that I think could be improved is a quick explanation of the app.

Ahe Group is incredibly professional and friendly. They clearly know what they’re doing and carry out their work efficiently and without any issues. It’s been a pleasure working with such a capable and reliable team.

Couldn't be happier with AHE, Leeanne and Andrew were awesome to work with, were prompt and had all the answers.The installation went quick and they were very tidy and courteous when explaining the system and how it integrated.

Highly recommended!

I talked to several solar and battery supplier/installers for quotations and most didn't have a good understanding of the systems they were selling, and even told me things I knew to be incorrect.
