Sam and the crew turned up on time and they only broke two roof tiles, which is exceptional in itself!The array is delivering exceptional performance and we're now wondering how to use all of the power that were generating.AHE are a small, family business that delivers a great product at an excellent price. I recommend Andrew, Sam and Leeanne to anyone looking for an excellent solar solution.

Andrew came out and give me a quote   The minute I saw him anll instantly liked him. He explained everything and I felt even more s when he mentioned that his son was part of the team.They arrived at 7.30am and worked quickly and methodically.When my son came over he could not believe how neat the job was.I am very pleased that we had picked such a hard working and component company.My wife and I highly recommend this company to do the job.

Andrew and his team far exceeded our expectations, they were all polite and friendly and very helpful answering all of our many questions. AHE Group price was competitive. Andrew's install team which included Andrew's son and himself and no subcontractors, did a very professional installation job of a roof solar system and battery at our home. All the joining cables were hidden, they arrived on time, finished on time, they were very tidy and cleaned up at the end of the day. We would have no hesitation in recommending AHE Group to do your solar or battery installation.Simon & JudyKellyville

I've just had a battery and more solar added to my house, after I used AHE originally 8 years ago. They replaced my original SMA inverter on warranty after part of it broke back in 2019.Installation was prompt and courteous. Andrew came back twice in two days to sort out a couple of issues commissioning the battery to our 3 phase supply and aircon.Customer service with Donna and the rest of the team has been very prompt.I've used them twice now and would recommend them to others.
Great local solar installer and nothing was a hassle. Recommend them for solar panels and batteries.

AHE installed our first PV installation in 2009. The system performed fault free from installation until replacement by AHE in early December 2024.In 2022 we purchased a Mitsubishi PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid EV), and the imminent replacement of our gas hot water system with a heat pump HWS will complete the conversion of our home to fully electric.The notional 5.7kW capacity of our original PV installation was not matching our increased electricity demands. Based on our experience with AHE, AHE was the ONLY installer we considered once we had decided to upgrade to a 12.3kW Enphase microinverter solution. AHE completed the installation by 1pm on the scheduled date. Some members of the AHE team were part of the team that completed our 2009 installation. As anticipated, the installation work was immaculate, and the system was online when the team departed. System performance has exceeded my expectations with December midday generation routinely peaking at 9.9kW.The attached images show the system's performance on 21Dec24 (longest day of the year) with some car charging and air conditioning demands. The other image shows the performance on 1Jun25 (another full-sun day three weeks before the shortest day of the year). There was little demand on 1Jun25 because we were away from home.The system has 28 440W Trina panels. The panels are installed on a 24 degree pitched tile roof. 11 facing NW, 13 facing NE, and 4 facing SE.We are on an AGL fixed tariff of 47.5 cents per kWh, supply fee of 96.49 cents per day and feed-in tariff of 20 cents per kWh. We have received a credit each month that now totals $636.I am exceedingly satisfied with AHE and the system.

Quoting process was straightforward.Installation was punctual, professional and the site was left neat and tidy. They also replaced some cracked tiles they discovered while doing my installation Very happy they let me know, and I supplied new tiles.Apps and smart meters were all set up with myself and the Energy Australia.
Was very with the team at AHE, very transparent process throughout and excellent job, especially happy with the electrical work.
From the very start Leeane, Andrew and their team are very easy to talk with. Excellent communication and knowledge made this whole challenging process a walk in the park.

Had been considering solar for a while but thought that the main part of my NW facing ground storey roof would be unsuitable due to  the shade of a large tree during the afternoon.As a result of a cold call door knock I received one quote from another supplier for a 4kW system with a very large price tag that would lock me into a 10 year payment plan.I thought that there had to be a better solution.After signing up to Solar Quotes I received a quote from AHE Solar for an 8 kW system with better panels and a better inverter for less cost than the first quoteAndrew was very knowledgeable and willing to answer all my solar questions and provide advice on the best solar configuration.  Leeanne and the admin team processed all the paperwork efficiently and professionally and guided me through the process that had to happen with my energy provider.Being a local operation, where they do their own installations, I have confidence that I will be well supported in the unlikely event of any problems.  I like the app that allows me to monitor the live solar performance data.In building the quote, Andrew suggested that problem caused by the shade on the lower roof could be solved by placing as many panels as possible on all 4 sections of the upper storey roof, a solution that I had not even considered was possible.That solution may not be able to have as many panels as first hoped, but by specifying a higher quality panel and micro inverters the system capacity would be sufficient to provide an attractive payback period.On the day of installation, the crew came prepared with extra panels in case they could “Tetris” more panels up there than what was on the original quote to provide the best possible solution.The installation was clean and efficient and the team were very good at keeping me informed of their progress and consulted with me to work out the best options for placement of the control box and the cabling.My most recent power bill arrived at the start of May.  The system was installed on 7th April.  The billing period ended 30th April. For the 23 days of solar across an 89 day billing period, my quarterly bill was $200 less than the prior quarter.I’m very happy with that result, especially since this time of year does not provide the ideal sun inclination for best solar generation.  Am looking forward to summer to see the increased performance. With numbers like that we look to be on track for a 2.5 - 3 year payback.

review_description: RK Solar successfully installed ~6kW of additional panels (on enphase micro inverters) and a Tesla Powerwall 2. We have three phase power so we wanted the additional panels on the Enphase micro inverters as well as most of the house wired to one particular phase (to allow for backup protection and self charging during a grid failure). They were able to do this.Almost 3 years down the track, the system continues to function well.Only one small drawback. At the end of their installation, the house wasn't protected by RCDs. I had to get another electrician to install RCDs to all the circuits. For safety purposes (as well as to allow for another small source of revenue) RK solar should have also installed the RCDs to make the house also immediately safe rather than relying on the consumer to source another electrician for the job.The Tesla app works well. The enphase app isn't working perfectly. Perhaps it wasn't wired up correctly.

review_description: Aside from initial discussion with their salesman, the entire episode has been nothing short of atrocious.Initially, we were happy to have solar panels installed. We were asked to refer them other potential customers and if they install a solar system there would be a "bonus" for us - We referred two other customers, it took in excess of 50 phone calls and a mountain of emails before any bonus was received (BTW a $150 shopping voucher - its the principle)Their web site also advises of such a bonus, and goes further to advise that amount of bonus is available on any number (all) referrals. Several months of promises which led to nothing.Finally spoke with their principle/owner who advised that he would only pay one bonus per person (we had referred 2). When pointed out to him that this was not what was advised, nor what is advertised on their web site. He claimed that he was not aware of what was on web site - but would honour payments as we were "good" customers and as a gesture of good faith.I suggested that he really reconsider his statement as we had an email from his company (Operations Manager) confirming receipt of installation of the two referred customers, this, in addition to information freely available on web site.We eventually (nearly 12 month's later received the gift vouchers).Since installation,. the system continued to disconnect from its internet connection hence, not providing a reading of the panels' performance.Several emails and mountains of telephone calls eventually resulted in one of their technician coming across (their office and our house are some 2 klm apart). He was not able to reconnect to internet. Eventually with help of the Enphase help desk he was able to reconnect.System continued to disconnect continuously and with the help of a technician from another company we were able to reconnect it. Why a technician from another company?- RK solar do not respond to email (nor their principle)- RK Solar do not return telephone calls (nor their principle)When eventually we did make contact, they (including their principle) assured me that they had returned telephone calls and we did not pick-up. I advised that  there were no missed calls on my mobile, there were no phone messages left (BTW this is my work phone - I cannot afford to miss, overlook or not return a missed call or message).I asked that they provide telephone listing - in a digital world this should not be a problem. Believe it or not, their telephone system resets itself weekly?, monthly? - He (The principle) was not sure how often but, it had reset itself that day as such, no records to provide proof of phone calls.He agreed to send a technician out to have a look at it once again and re-connect system. The technician that he sent was not able to re-connect without the help of the Enphase helpdesk.We were then advised that issue was our internet system. Notwithstanding that we operated 3 lap tops, 3 televisions, 4 mobile telephones and a hand set (my wife and I work from home, cannot do so without internet). He was adamant that issue was with our internet.We paid out our existing contract and contracted to a new provider. Same issue - everything at home worked but, the solar system would not remain connected.After several attempts to contact, principle advised that  he would send technician out to us at a cost of $250-00, as the issue was with our internet. Explained that we had changed provider - He advised that would send technician free of cost for the last time.Again, technician took over an hour to reconnect and not without the help of the help desk.We were advised that issue was with our internet and we needed to change again.We had NBN (fibre optic) cables put in the house by an electrician at a cost of $1,200-00. Cancelled new contract and installed Telstra NBN (cabled).Still disconnected - everything else was fine.All of this time I kept telling them (principle and technicians) that we had been advised by The "other" technician that had helped us early in piece (from another company) that it was his opinion that Enphase/solar system be looked at as he did not feel it was working as it should be.On many occasion they assured me that it was the internet, not the system and they had the best technicians.When I threatened to take matter to Fair Trade, they agreed to replace the equipment.Guess what! the new equipment they installed, connected immediately, has not disconnected once and it works fantastically.This company and its principle lack any form of customer service, are misleading, do not return telephone calls, do not reply to emails.This company has cost us time and money above the cost of the solar system itself and we are so disappointed we chose them. We have had no contact from them, nor an apology.Please keep away

We were given the name of Smart Energy Answers by Solar Quotes.We had had problems getting people to quote for solar / battery for our dwelling, because of the heritage listed front face of our terrace in inner city City of Sydney, and also a tricky site. The solar panels had to be installed on both the main house and the granny flat, and the roof pitch of both is steep.But Smart Energy Answers were willing to work with us and we got a great system. It took about fours weeks and two site visits, but we got a quote for a 6.65 kW of solar panels (14 x 475W panels) together with a 24.2 kWh Sigen battery with Gateway SP and inverter for $17,893.70, after Federal and NSW State government rebates. Part of this quote included contingency money, which was good, because we did have problems in installation because of the large run of cables from the front to back of our block. So, the system did come in for the price first quoted.One specification I had was that the system should be Amber compatible, which drove the selection of battery brand.Anyway, it took a bit less than three months from accepting the quote to the completed installation. We were kept informed at every step, and if I had queries, they were answered swiftly.We worked with Conor Gardiner from the outset, and he was really quick to answer my emails after installation.I was also very happy with the installers, who were able to work with the steep roofs and long runs of cables - and the lack of a ceiling cavity! And they quickly noted that our battery would be in the sun for much of the day, and installed an awning.I have learned that the old terrace houses require people who have experience with them, from air conditioning installation to getting a new kitchen. And, it can be more expensive. So while I have heard of people paying less for what we got, they all seem to be installations on recent-build freestanding dwellings, which are cheaper and easier to work with.And, now that four weeks have passed since the installation, we could not be happier. The Sigen App is a joy to behold. We have imported solely 0.7 kWh from the grid since the installation. Our previous rates were 33 cents per kWh, with a $2 per day connection charge.Once Amber install a Smart Meter in the next couple of weeks, we will also be getting paid to export to the grid, and I will see how it goes, but I think we are looking at a pay-back period of less than 4 years.
